BEGIN

 END IF;

Trigger.Name: WHEN-BUTTON-PRESSED
Trigger.TriggerText:
DECLARE
 RET NUMBER;

BEGIN
 BELL;
 COMMIT;

 IF NOT ID_NULL(FIND_FORM('SUPPORT_ENTRY')) AND :SYSTEM.FORM_STATUS = 'QUERY' THEN
 CLOSE_FORM('SUPPORT_ENTRY');
 END IF;

 :title.user_name := :PARAMETER.P_USER_NAME;
 :title.SCREEN_NAME := :PARAMETER.P_MODULE_NAME;
 :title.SYSTEM_DATE := HIJDATE.Cur_Hij_Date;
end;

Trigger.Name: WHEN-BUTTON-PRESSED
Trigger.TriggerText:
DECLARE
 RET VARCHAR2(10);
 PROP VARCHAR2(10);
BEGIN
 IF NOT ID_NULL(FIND_FORM('SUPPORT_ENTRY')) THEN
 CLOSE_FORM('SUPPORT_ENTRY');
 END IF;

IF :GLOBAL.EXIT = 2 THEN
 RET := STR.DISPAlert('يجب ادخال بنود للتعهد او حذف التعهد','INFORMATION');
 RAISE FORM_TRIGGER_FAILURE;

ELSIF :GLOBAL.EXIT = 0 THEN
 PROP := GET_ITEM_PROPERTY('SAVE',VISIBLE);

 EXIT_FORM(NO_VALIDATE);

END IF;
END;

Trigger.Name: WHEN-MOUSE-UP
Trigger.TriggerText:
DECLARE
 vis varchar2(200);
BEGIN

 vis := GET_VIEW_PROPERTY('LSIDE', visible);

 if vis = 'TRUE' then
 SET_VIEW_PROPERTY('LSIDE', visible, property_false);
 GO_ITEM(NAME_IN('PARAMETER.P_CURRENT_ITEM'));
 COPY('', 'PARAMETER.P_CURRENT_ITEM');
 else
 TMPLT.Populate_Functions ;
 end if;

END;

Trigger.Name: WHEN-MOUSE-DOWN
Trigger.TriggerText:
DECLARE
 vis varchar2(200);
BEGIN

 vis := GET_VIEW_PROPERTY('LSIDE', visible);

 IF vis = 'FALSE' THEN
 COPY(NAME_IN('SYSTEM.CURSOR_ITEM'), 'PARAMETER.P_CURRENT_ITEM');
 ADJ_FUNS;
 GO_ITEM('DUMMY');
 END IF;

END;

Trigger.Name: KEY-UP

END IF;

Trigger.Name: KEY-NEXT-ITEM
Trigger.TriggerText:
BEGIN
IF TMPLT.USING_KEYB = TRUE THEN
 Set_Item_Property('LSIDE.FN'||TMPLT.CURSOR_AT, VISUAL_ATTRIBUTE, 'STD_NORMAL_FUNCTION');
 Execute_Function('LSIDE.FN'||TMPLT.CURSOR_AT);
 GO_ITEM(NAME_IN('PARAMETER.P_CURRENT_ITEM'));
 COPY ('', 'PARAMETER.P_CURRENT_ITEM');
 TMPLT.USING_KEYB := FALSE;
 TMPLT.CURSOR_AT := 0;
END IF;
END;

Trigger.Name: WHEN-VALIDATE-ITEM
Trigger.TriggerText:
DECLARE
V_COUNT NUMBER;
BEGIN
IF :DCLTN_HDR.DCLTN_ISN IS NULL THEN

 SELECT COUNT(DCLTN_NBR) INTO V_COUNT FROM DECLARATIONS
 WHERE PORT_CD = :DCLTN_HDR.PORT_CD
 AND DCLTN_NBR = :DCLTN_HDR.DCLTN_NBR;

 IF V_COUNT > 1 THEN
 :GLOBAL.COUNTER := 1;
 :GLOBAL.DCLTN_PORT_CD := :DCLTN_HDR.PORT_CD;
 :global.Exec_QRy_Now := 1;
 DECLTN_LOV;

 ELSIF V_COUNT = 1 THEN
 :GLOBAL.COUNTER := 1;
 SELECT DCLTN_ISN,DCLTN_DT INTO :DCLTN_HDR.DCLTN_ISN,:DCLTN_HDR.DCLTN_DT FROM DECLARATIONS
 WHERE PORT_CD = :DCLTN_HDR.PORT_CD
 AND DCLTN_NBR = :DCLTN_HDR.DCLTN_NBR;

 :GLOBAL.DCLTN_PORT_CD := :DCLTN_HDR.PORT_CD;
 :GLOBAL.DCLTN_ISN := :DCLTN_HDR.DCLTN_ISN;
 :global.Exec_QRy_Now := 1;

 END IF;
ELSE
 :GLOBAL.COUNTER := 0;
END IF;
END;

Trigger.Name: ON-ERROR
Trigger.TriggerText:
/* CGAP$OLES_SEQUENCE_BEFORE */
BEGIN
 DECLARE
 err_code CONSTANT NUMBER := ERROR_CODE;
 err_type CONSTANT VARCHAR2(3) := ERROR_TYPE;
 server_err NUMBER := abs(DBMS_ERROR_CODE);
 server_msg VARCHAR2(2000) := DBMS_ERROR_TEXT;
 constraint_name VARCHAR2(61);
 BEGIN
 IF server_err = 1031 THEN
IF (err_type = 'FRM' AND
 err_code = 40508 ) THEN
Des$Form_errors.PUSH('ليس لديك صلاحية الادخال ' ,'E', 'OFG',0);
END IF;
IF (err_type = 'FRM' AND
 err_code = 40509 ) THEN
Des$Form_errors.PUSH('ليس لديك صلاحية التعديل' ,'E', 'OFG',0);
END IF;
IF (err_type = 'FRM' AND
 err_code = 40510 ) THEN
Des$Form_errors.PUSH('ليس لديك صلاحية الحذف' ,'E', 'OFG',0);
END IF;
END IF;
 END;
 END;
/* CGTE$BLK_LEVEL_ERROR_TRAP */
/* Trap errors returning from the server and report in a user friendly manner */
BEGIN
 DECLARE
 err_code CONSTANT NUMBER := ERROR_CODE;
 err_type CONSTANT VARCHAR2(3) := ERROR_TYPE;
 server_err NUMBER := abs(DBMS_ERROR_CODE);
 server_msg VARCHAR2(2000) := DBMS_ERROR_TEXT;
 constraint_name VARCHAR2(61);
 BEGIN
 IF (err_type = 'FRM' AND
 err_code IN (40506, 40508, 40509, 40510) ) THEN

 /* Remove recursive errors from the top of the stack */
 WHILE (server_err = 604) LOOP
 CGTE$POP_ERROR_STACK(server_err, server_msg);
 END LOOP;

 /* Check and report the generic constraint violations */
 IF ( CGTE$CHECK_CONSTRAINT_VIO(server_err, server_msg) ) THEN
 Des$Form_errors.RAISE_FAILURE;
 END IF;

 /* Check and report the constraint violations specific to this block */
 constraint_name := CGTE$STRIP_CONSTRAINT(server_msg);

 /* FK - Parent key not found */
 IF (server_err = 2291) THEN
 IF (constraint_name = 'DCLTN_TYPE_FK') THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH(Des$Form_errors.MSGGETTEXT(13, 'This <p1> does not exist', 'نوع البيان' ), 'E', 'OFG', 13);
 ELSIF (constraint_name = 'DCLTN_TIR_HEAD_FK') THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH(Des$Form_errors.MSGGETTEXT(13, 'This <p1> does not exist', 'TIR_HQ_SEQ' ), 'E', 'OFG', 13);
 ELSIF (constraint_name = 'DCLTN_TERMN_USR_FK') THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH('خطأ في رمز المستخدم', 'E', 'OFG', 0);
 ELSIF (constraint_name = 'DCLTN_STATUS_FK') THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH(Des$Form_errors.MSGGETTEXT(13, 'This <p1> does not exist', 'نوع البيان' ), 'E', 'OFG', 13);
 ELSIF (constraint_name = 'DCLTN_SPCL_DEPT_FK') THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH('خطأ في رمز جهة الأوضاع الخاصه', 'E', 'OFG', 0);
 ELSIF (constraint_name = 'DCLTN_PORT_FK') THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH('خطأ في رمز الجمرك', 'E', 'OFG', 0);
 ELSIF (constraint_name = 'DCLTN_MNFCT_IMPR_FK') THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH(Des$Form_errors.MSGGETTEXT(13, 'This <p1> does not exist', 'PORT_CD,MNFCT_NBR' ), 'E', 'OFG', 13);
 ELSIF (constraint_name = 'DCLTN_INSPECTOR_FK') THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH('خطأ في رقم المعاين - إستخدم القائمة للإختيار', 'E', 'OFG', 0);
 ELSIF (constraint_name = 'DCLTN_IMP_FK') THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH(Des$Form_errors.MSGGETTEXT(13, 'This <p1> does not exist', 'رمـز الجمـرك' ), 'E', 'OFG', 13);
 ELSIF (constraint_name = 'DCLTN_GROUP_FK') THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH(Des$Form_errors.MSGGETTEXT(13, 'This <p1> does not exist', 'رمـز الجمـرك' ), 'E', 'OFG', 13);
 ELSIF (constraint_name = 'DCLTN_FRIMEX_FK') THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH(Des$Form_errors.MSGGETTEXT(13, 'This <p1> does not exist', 'FRGN_IMP_EXP_SEQ' ), 'E', 'OFG', 13);
 ELSIF (constraint_name = 'DCLTN_EXIT_PORT_FK') THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH('خطأ في رمز منفذ الخروج', 'E', 'OFG', 0);
 ELSIF (constraint_name = 'DCLTN_DHLOWN_FK') THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH('خطأ في مالك بوليصة البريد السريع الدولي - إستخدم القائمة للإختيار', 'E', 'OFG', 0);
 ELSIF (constraint_name = 'DCLTN_CTRY_FK') THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH('خطأ في دولة الوصول النهائي', 'E', 'OFG', 0);
 ELSIF (constraint_name = 'DCLTN_BRKRAUTH_FK') THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH(Des$Form_errors.MSGGETTEXT(13, 'This <p1> does not exist', 'BRKR_ATHRZTN_NBR,PORT_CD' ), 'E', 'OFG', 13);
 ELSIF (constraint_name = 'DCLTN_BKM_FK') THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH('خطأ في رقم الرخصة - إستخدم القائمة للإختيار', 'E', 'OFG', 0);
 ELSIF (constraint_name = 'DCLTN_AG_AUTH_FK') THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH(Des$Form_errors.MSGGETTEXT(13, 'This <p1> does not exist', 'AGNT_ATHRZTN_NBR,PORT_CD' ), 'E', 'OFG', 13);
 ELSIF (constraint_name = 'DCLTN_AGNT_IMPR_FK') THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH('خطأ في بيانات الشركة الوسيطة - إستخدم القائمة للإختيار', 'E', 'OFG', 0);
 ELSIF (constraint_name = 'DCLTN_AEO_REAS_FK') THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH('خطأ في بيانات سبب اختيار المشغل الأقتصادى - إستخدم القائمة للإختيار', 'E', 'OFG', 0);
 ELSE
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH(server_msg, 'I', 'OFG', 0);
 END IF;
 Des$Form_errors.RAISE_FAILURE;
 END IF;

 /* FK - Child record found */
 IF (server_err = 2292) THEN
 IF (err_code = 40509) THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH(server_msg, 'I', 'OFG', 0);
 END IF;
 Des$Form_errors.RAISE_FAILURE;
 END IF;
 END IF;

 IF (err_type = 'FRM' AND
 err_code = 40735 ) THEN


 /* Remove recursive errors from the top of the stack */
 WHILE (server_err = 604) LOOP
 CGTE$POP_ERROR_STACK(server_err, server_msg);
 END LOOP;

 /* If error not found, issue default message */
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH(err_type||'-'||to_char(server_err)||': '||server_msg, 'I', 'OFG', 0);
 Des$Form_errors.RAISE_FAILURE;
 END IF;

 /* If error not found, issue default message */
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH(err_type||'-'||to_char(err_code)||': '||ERROR_TEXT, 'I', 'OFG', 0);
 Des$Form_errors.RAISE_FAILURE;

 END;
END;

DECLARE

 CURSOR DSDR IS
 SELECT DSDR_SPCL_DEPT_ID FROM DCLTN_SPC_DEPT_RCV
 WHERE PORT_CD = :DCLTN_HDR.PORT_CD
 AND DCLTN_ISN = :DCLTN_HDR.DCLTN_ISN
 AND WORK_FLAG = 0
 ;

 V_DEPT_NAME VARCHAR2(200);


BEGIN
 SELECT COUNT(*) INTO V_CNT FROM DCLTN_SPC_DEPT_RCV
 WHERE PORT_CD = :DCLTN_HDR.PORT_CD
 AND DCLTN_ISN = :DCLTN_HDR.DCLTN_ISN
 AND WORK_FLAG = 0
 ;

 AND REC_STATUS = 1

 END IF;

/* CGFK$QRY_LOOKUP_DATA */
/* Query lookup data for the foreign key(s) */
BEGIN
 IF (name_in('DCLTN_HDR.DCLTN_TYPE_CD') IS NOT NULL OR name_in('DCLTN_HDR.DCLTN_STA_CD') IS NOT NULL) THEN
 BEGIN
 CGFK$QRY_DCLTN_HDR_DCLTN_STATU(
 :DCLTN_HDR.DCLTN_TYPE_NAME /* MOD: Value in Item :DCLTN_HDR.DCLTN_TYPE_NAME. */
 ,:DCLTN_HDR.DCLTN_ST_DCLTN_STA_DESC /* MOD: Value in Item :DCLTN_HDR.DCLTN_ST_DCLTN_STA_DESC. */
 ,:DCLTN_HDR.DCLTN_TYPE_CD /* IN : Value in Item :DCLTN_HDR.DCLTN_TYPE_CD. */
 ,:DCLTN_HDR.DCLTN_STA_CD ); /* IN : Value in Item :DCLTN_HDR.DCLTN_STA_CD. */
 EXCEPTION
 WHEN NO_DATA_FOUND THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH(Des$Form_errors.MSGGETTEXT(13, 'This <p1> does not exist', 'نوع البيان' ), 'E', 'OFG', 13);
 WHEN OTHERS THEN
 CGTE$OTHER_EXCEPTIONS;
 END;
 SET_RECORD_PROPERTY(:SYSTEM.TRIGGER_RECORD, 'DCLTN_HDR', STATUS , QUERY_STATUS);
 ELSE
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH(Des$Form_errors.MSGGETTEXT(78, '<p1> must be entered', 'نوع البيان' ), 'E', 'OFG', 78);
 Des$Form_errors.RAISE_FAILURE;
 END IF;
 IF (name_in('DCLTN_HDR.PORT_CD') IS NOT NULL) THEN
 BEGIN
 CGFK$QRY_DCLTN_HDR_DCLTN_PORT_(
 :DCLTN_HDR.PORT_NAME /* MOD: Value in Item :DCLTN_HDR.PORT_NAME. */
 ,:DCLTN_HDR.PORT_CD ); /* IN : Value in Item :DCLTN_HDR.PORT_CD. */
 EXCEPTION
 WHEN NO_DATA_FOUND THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH('خطأ في رمز الجمرك', 'E', 'OFG', 0);
 WHEN OTHERS THEN
 CGTE$OTHER_EXCEPTIONS;
 END;
 SET_RECORD_PROPERTY(:SYSTEM.TRIGGER_RECORD, 'DCLTN_HDR', STATUS , QUERY_STATUS);
 END IF;

Trigger.TriggerText:
BEGIN

 :DCLTN_HDR.PORT_CD := :PARAMETER.P_DCLTN_PORT_CD;

 END IF;

IF NVL(Gnrl.Get_Customs_Setting(:PARAMETER.P_CURR_PORT_CD,'CNTRL_DATABASE',999),0) = 1 AND :PARAMETER.P_CURR_PORT_CD NOT IN(98,99) THEN /* Central By Nasser 25-05-2025 */
 Set_Block_Property('DCLTN_HDR', Default_Where, 'DECLARATIONS.PORT_CD = '||:PARAMETER.P_CURR_PORT_CD );
END IF;

/* CGFK$DEFAULT_WHERE */
/* Add restrictive query on FK items if value(s) entered in non-table items */
/* and/or if there are items which may contain nulls as valid values. Code to */
/* restrict the query is added to the default where clause of the block. */
BEGIN
 DECLARE
 block_id Block := find_block('DCLTN_HDR');
 sub_where VARCHAR2(4000) := NULL;
 def_where VARCHAR2(4000) := NULL;
 r_string VARCHAR2(512) := NULL;

 FUNCTION add_and(
 P_WHERE IN VARCHAR2
 ) RETURN VARCHAR2 IS
 BEGIN
 IF (nvl( length(P_WHERE), 0) != 0) THEN
 RETURN( P_WHERE || ' AND ');
 ELSE
 RETURN( P_WHERE );
 END IF;
 END;

 BEGIN
 IF ( CG$DCLN2240_GLOBALS.DCLTN_HDR_WHERE = 'first_time') THEN
 CG$DCLN2240_GLOBALS.DCLTN_HDR_WHERE := get_block_property(block_id, DEFAULT_WHERE);
 END IF;
 def_where := CG$DCLN2240_GLOBALS.DCLTN_HDR_WHERE;

 sub_where := NULL;
 r_string := NAME_IN('DCLTN_HDR.DCLTN_ST_DCLTN_STA_DESC');
 IF (r_string IS NOT NULL) THEN
 BEGIN
 IF substr(r_string, 1,1) IN ('<','>','=') THEN
 sub_where := add_and( sub_where ) || '(DCLTN_STA_DESC '|| r_string || ')';
 ELSIF substr(r_string, 1,1) ='#' THEN
 sub_where := add_and( sub_where ) || '(DCLTN_STA_DESC '|| substr(r_string,2) || ')';
 ELSIF instr(r_string, '%') <> 0 THEN
 sub_where := add_and( sub_where ) || '(DCLTN_STA_DESC LIKE '''|| replace(r_string,'''','''''') || ''')';
 ELSE
 sub_where := add_and( sub_where ) || '(DCLTN_STA_DESC ='''|| replace(r_string,'''','''''') || ''')';
 END IF;
 END;
 END IF;
 IF (sub_where IS NOT NULL) THEN
 def_where := add_and( def_where ) || '((nvl(to_char(DCLTN_STA_CD), ''CG$NULL''), DCLTN_TYPE_CD) IN '||'(SELECT nvl(to_char(DCLTN_STA_CD), ''CG$NULL''), DCLTN_TYPE_CD '||'FROM DCLTN_STATUS WHERE '|| sub_where || '))';
 END IF;

 set_block_property(block_id, DEFAULT_WHERE, def_where);

 EXCEPTION
 WHEN VALUE_ERROR THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH(Des$Form_errors.MSGGETTEXT(33, 'Query criteria too complex - simplify and re-query'), 'E', 'OFG', 33);
 Des$Form_errors.RAISE_FAILURE;
 END;
END;

Trigger.Name: ON-ERROR
Trigger.TriggerText:
/* CGAP$OLES_SEQUENCE_BEFORE */
BEGIN
 DECLARE
 err_code CONSTANT NUMBER := ERROR_CODE;
 err_type CONSTANT VARCHAR2(3) := ERROR_TYPE;
 server_err NUMBER := abs(DBMS_ERROR_CODE);
 server_msg VARCHAR2(2000) := DBMS_ERROR_TEXT;
 constraint_name VARCHAR2(61);
 BEGIN
 IF server_err = 1031 THEN
IF (err_type = 'FRM' AND
 err_code = 40508 ) THEN
Des$Form_errors.PUSH('ليس لديك صلاحية الادخال ' ,'E', 'OFG',0);
END IF;
IF (err_type = 'FRM' AND
 err_code = 40509 ) THEN
Des$Form_errors.PUSH('ليس لديك صلاحية التعديل' ,'E', 'OFG',0);
END IF;
IF (err_type = 'FRM' AND
 err_code = 40510 ) THEN
Des$Form_errors.PUSH('ليس لديك صلاحية الحذف' ,'E', 'OFG',0);
END IF;
END IF;
 END;
 END;
/* CGTE$BLK_LEVEL_ERROR_TRAP */
/* Trap errors returning from the server and report in a user friendly manner */
BEGIN
 DECLARE
 err_code CONSTANT NUMBER := ERROR_CODE;
 err_type CONSTANT VARCHAR2(3) := ERROR_TYPE;
 server_err NUMBER := abs(DBMS_ERROR_CODE);
 server_msg VARCHAR2(2000) := DBMS_ERROR_TEXT;
 constraint_name VARCHAR2(61);
 BEGIN
 IF (err_type = 'FRM' AND
 err_code IN (40506, 40508, 40509, 40510) ) THEN

 /* Remove recursive errors from the top of the stack */
 WHILE (server_err = 604) LOOP
 CGTE$POP_ERROR_STACK(server_err, server_msg);
 END LOOP;

 /* Check and report the generic constraint violations */
 IF ( CGTE$CHECK_CONSTRAINT_VIO(server_err, server_msg) ) THEN
 Des$Form_errors.RAISE_FAILURE;
 END IF;

 /* Check and report the constraint violations specific to this block */
 constraint_name := CGTE$STRIP_CONSTRAINT(server_msg);

 /* FK - Parent key not found */
 IF (server_err = 2291) THEN
 IF (constraint_name = 'DCLTN_IT_XRD_FK') THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH('خطأ في بيانات نوع الإعفاء المستخدم - إستخدم القائمة للإختيار', 'E', 'OFG', 0);
 ELSIF (constraint_name = 'DCLTN_IT_SDP_FK3') THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH('خطأ في رمز الجمرك - إستخدم القائمة للإختيار', 'E', 'OFG', 0);
 ELSIF (constraint_name = 'DCLTN_IT_SDP_FK2') THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH('خطأ في رمز جمرك الإستيراد للصنف المعاد تصديره', 'E', 'OFG', 0);
 ELSIF (constraint_name = 'DCLTN_IT_SDP_FK') THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH('خطأ في رمز الجمرك - إستخدم القائمة للإختيار', 'E', 'OFG', 0);
 ELSIF (constraint_name = 'DCLTN_IT_RETITM_FK') THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH('خطأ فى االرابطة بين أصناف البيان و أصناف محضر الحجز', 'E', 'OFG', 0);
 ELSIF (constraint_name = 'DCLTN_IT_RACT_FK') THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH(Des$Form_errors.MSGGETTEXT(13, 'This <p1> does not exist', 'RACT_ACTION_NBR,PORT_CD,RACT_RET_BILL_NBR,RACT_AC' ), 'E', 'OFG', 13);
 ELSIF (constraint_name = 'DCLTN_IT_MU_FK') THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH('خطأ في رمز وحدة القياس علي الفاتورة - إستخدم القائمة للإختيار', 'E', 'OFG', 0);
 ELSIF (constraint_name = 'DCLTN_IT_LSITMS_FK') THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH('خطأ فى بيانات المبيعات', 'E', 'OFG', 0);
 ELSIF (constraint_name = 'DCLTN_IT_LFTITM_FK') THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH('خطأ فى االرابطة بين أصناف البيان و أصناف محضر المتروكات', 'E', 'OFG', 0);
 ELSIF (constraint_name = 'DCLTN_IT_LACIT_FK') THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH(Des$Form_errors.MSGGETTEXT(13, 'This <p1> does not exist', 'LACIT_ACTION_CD,LACIT_LFT_ITEM_NBR,PORT_CD,LACIT_' ), 'E', 'OFG', 13);
 ELSIF (constraint_name = 'DCLTN_IT_INS_TRF_EXP_FK') THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH(Des$Form_errors.MSGGETTEXT(13, 'This <p1> does not exist', 'INS_TARIFF_CD,INS_TARIFF_ANAL_CD' ), 'E', 'OFG', 13);
 ELSIF (constraint_name = 'DCLTN_IT_INS_TRFD_FK') THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH('خطأ في بند التعرفة الجمركية - إستخدم القائمة للإختيار', 'E', 'OFG', 0);
 ELSIF (constraint_name = 'DCLTN_IT_IMU_FK') THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH('خطأ في رمز وحدة القياس الدولية - إستخدم القائمة للإختيار', 'E', 'OFG', 0);

Trigger.Name: POST-QUERY
Trigger.TriggerText:
DECLARE
 I_QTY NUMBER;
BEGIN
 SELECT INTL_ITEM_QTY INTO I_QTY FROM RLSD_ITEMS WHERE (PORT_CD,RLSD_HDR_ISN,RLSD_ITM_SEQ)
 IN (SELECT PORT_CD, RLSD_HDR_ISN, RLSD_ITM_SEQ FROM RESTRCN_CNSMTNS
 WHERE (PORT_CD=:DCLTN_HDR.PORT_CD AND DCLTN_ITEM_ISN=:ITEM_ISN AND ROWNUM=1))
 AND NVL(CUSTOMS_APPROVE,0) <> 2---AAA
 ;

 IF I_QTY > 0 THEN
 :U_QTY := :INTL_QTY;
ELSE
 :U_QTY := :INV_QTY;
END IF;

EXCEPTION
 WHEN NO_DATA_FOUND THEN
 :U_QTY:=NULL;
END;

Trigger.Name: ON-ERROR
Trigger.TriggerText:
/* CGTE$BLK_LEVEL_ERROR_TRAP */
/* Trap errors returning from the server and report in a user friendly manner */
BEGIN
 DECLARE
 err_code CONSTANT NUMBER := ERROR_CODE;
 err_type CONSTANT VARCHAR2(3) := ERROR_TYPE;
 server_err NUMBER := abs(DBMS_ERROR_CODE);
 server_msg VARCHAR2(2000) := DBMS_ERROR_TEXT;
 constraint_name VARCHAR2(61);
 BEGIN
 IF (err_type = 'FRM' AND
 err_code IN (40506, 40508, 40509, 40510) ) THEN

 /* Remove recursive errors from the top of the stack */
 WHILE (server_err = 604) LOOP
 CGTE$POP_ERROR_STACK(server_err, server_msg);
 END LOOP;

 /* Check and report the generic constraint violations */
 IF ( CGTE$CHECK_CONSTRAINT_VIO(server_err, server_msg) ) THEN
 Des$Form_errors.RAISE_FAILURE;
 END IF;

 /* Check and report the constraint violations specific to this block */
 constraint_name := CGTE$STRIP_CONSTRAINT(server_msg);

 /* FK - Parent key not found */
 IF (server_err = 2291) THEN
 IF (constraint_name = 'RCN_SDP_FK') THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH('خطأ في بيانات صنف خطاب السلع المقيدة - إستخدم القائمة للإختيار', 'E', 'OFG', 0);
 ELSIF (constraint_name = 'RCN_RI_FK') THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH('خطأ في بيانات صنف خطاب السلع المقيدة - إستخدم القائمة للإختيار', 'E', 'OFG', 0);
 ELSIF (constraint_name = 'RCN_ERRRD_FK') THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH('خطأ في بيانات صنف خطاب حسم السلع المقيدة من منفذ أخر', 'E', 'OFG', 0);
 ELSIF (constraint_name = 'RCN_DCLTN_IT_FK') THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH('خطأ في بيانات صنف البيان الجمركي - إستخدم القائمة للإختيار', 'E', 'OFG', 0);
 ELSE
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH(server_msg, 'I', 'OFG', 0);
 END IF;
 Des$Form_errors.RAISE_FAILURE;
 END IF;

 /* FK - Child record found */
 IF (server_err = 2292) THEN
 IF (err_code = 40510) THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH(server_msg, 'I', 'OFG', 0);
 ELSIF (err_code = 40509) THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH(server_msg, 'I', 'OFG', 0);
 END IF;
 Des$Form_errors.RAISE_FAILURE;
 END IF;
 END IF;

 IF (err_type = 'FRM' AND
 err_code IN (41105, 41106) ) THEN
 IF (err_code = 41105) THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH(Des$Form_errors.MSGGETTEXT(35, 'Query of <p1> must be in context of <p2>', 'فسح السلع المقيدة','الأصناف' ), 'E', 'OFG', 35);
 Des$Form_errors.RAISE_FAILURE;
 ELSIF (err_code = 41106) THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH(Des$Form_errors.MSGGETTEXT(36, 'Insert of <p1> must be in context of <p2>', 'فسح السلع المقيدة','الأصناف' ), 'E', 'OFG', 36);
 Des$Form_errors.RAISE_FAILURE;
 END IF;
 END IF;

 IF (err_type = 'FRM' AND
 err_code = 40735 ) THEN


 /* Remove recursive errors from the top of the stack */
 WHILE (server_err = 604) LOOP
 CGTE$POP_ERROR_STACK(server_err, server_msg);
 END LOOP;

 /* If error not found, issue default message */
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH(err_type||'-'||to_char(server_err)||': '||server_msg, 'I', 'OFG', 0);
 Des$Form_errors.RAISE_FAILURE;
 END IF;

 /* If error not found, issue default message */
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH(err_type||'-'||to_char(err_code)||': '||ERROR_TEXT, 'I', 'OFG', 0);
 Des$Form_errors.RAISE_FAILURE;

 END;
END;

Trigger.Name: POST-QUERY
Trigger.TriggerText:
/* DEVELOPER :KAMEL ELSAYED
 DATE :25/10/2007
 MODIFICATION :DEVLOPED FORM TO ACCEPT THE REQUEST EXTERNAL CLERN. LETTER FROM ANOTHER PORT*/
BEGIN
--**KAMEL
IF :RESTRCN_CNSMTNS.RES_TYPE=1 THEN
 :RESTRCN_CNSMTNS.REQ_PORT := :RESTRCN_CNSMTNS.PORT_CD;
 :RESTRCN_CNSMTNS.RLSD_REQ_ISN:=:RESTRCN_CNSMTNS.RLSD_HDR_ISN;
 :RESTRCN_CNSMTNS.RLSD_REQ_SEQ:=:RESTRCN_CNSMTNS.RLSD_ITM_SEQ;
ELSIF :RESTRCN_CNSMTNS.RES_TYPE=2 THEN
 :RESTRCN_CNSMTNS.REQ_PORT := :RESTRCN_CNSMTNS.RLSD_PORT_CD;
--05082009 :RESTRCN_CNSMTNS.RLSD_REQ_ISN:=:RESTRCN_CNSMTNS.REQ_ISN;
 :RESTRCN_CNSMTNS.RLSD_REQ_ISN:=:RESTRCN_CNSMTNS.LOC_NBR;
 :RESTRCN_CNSMTNS.RLSD_REQ_SEQ:=:RESTRCN_CNSMTNS.REQ_ITEM_SEQ;
END IF;

IF :RESTRCN_CNSMTNS.RES_TYPE=1 THEN
 IF (name_in('RESTRCN_CNSMTNS.RLSD_HDR_ISN') IS NOT NULL AND name_in('RESTRCN_CNSMTNS.RLSD_ITM_SEQ') IS NOT NULL AND name_in('RESTRCN_CNSMTNS.PORT_CD') IS NOT NULL) THEN
 BEGIN
 SELECT RI.HRMNZD_CODE
 ,RI.ITEM_QTY
 ,RI.MSR_UNIT
 ,RI.ITEM_BALNCE
 ,RI.DSC_SEQ
 ,RI.INTL_ITEM_QTY
 ,L_MU.MSR_ARBC_NAME
 INTO :RESTRCN_CNSMTNS.RI_HRMNZD_CODE , :RESTRCN_CNSMTNS.ITEM_QTY ,:RESTRCN_CNSMTNS.RI_MSR_UNIT
 ,:RESTRCN_CNSMTNS.ITEM_BALNCE,:RESTRCN_CNSMTNS.RI_DSC_SEQ ,
 :RESTRCN_CNSMTNS.INTL_ITEM_QTY,:RESTRCN_CNSMTNS.RI_MSR_NAME
 FROM RLSD_ITEMS RI
 ,MEASURE_UNITS L_MU
 WHERE (RI.PORT_CD = :RESTRCN_CNSMTNS.PORT_CD)
 AND (RI.RLSD_HDR_ISN =:RESTRCN_CNSMTNS.RLSD_REQ_ISN)
 AND (RI.RLSD_ITM_SEQ =:RESTRCN_CNSMTNS.RLSD_REQ_SEQ)
 AND (NVL(RI.CUSTOMS_APPROVE,0) <> 2)---AAA
 AND (L_MU.MSR_UNIT (+) = RI.MSR_UNIT);
 EXCEPTION
 WHEN NO_DATA_FOUND THEN
 STR.DISPALERT('خطأ في بيانات صنف خطاب السلع المقيدة' ,'ERROR');
 RAISE FORM_TRIGGER_FAILURE;
 END;
END IF;

IF :APRVD=0 THEN
:ITEM_BALNCE:=:ITEM_BALNCE-:R_QTY;
END IF;

IF :INTL_ITEM_QTY > 0 THEN
 :MESURED_UNIT:= :INTL_MSR_NAME;
ELSE
 :MESURED_UNIT:= :INV_MSR_NAME;
END IF;
BEGIN
 IF :PARAMETER.P_MSUR_U IS NULL THEN
 :PARAMETER.P_MSUR_U :=:MESURED_UNIT;
 ELSE
 IF :PARAMETER.P_MSUR_U <> :MESURED_UNIT THEN
 MESSAGE('وحدة القياس لخطاب فسح السلعة المقيدة مختلفة عن الخطابات السابقة');
 RAISE FORM_TRIGGER_FAILURE;
 END IF;

 END IF;
 END ;
 SET_RECORD_PROPERTY(:SYSTEM.TRIGGER_RECORD, 'RESTRCN_CNSMTNS', STATUS ,QUERY_STATUS);
ELSIF :RESTRCN_CNSMTNS.RES_TYPE=2 THEN
 IF (name_in('RESTRCN_CNSMTNS.REQ_ISN') IS NOT NULL AND name_in('RESTRCN_CNSMTNS.REQ_ITEM_SEQ') IS NOT NULL AND name_in('RESTRCN_CNSMTNS.PORT_CD') IS NOT NULL) THEN
BEGIN
 SELECT ERRRD.actl_avlbl_qty, ERRRD.actl_avlbl_qty,ERRRD.HRMNZD_CODE,IMU.MSR_ARBC_NAME,ERRRD.INTL_MSR_UNIT
 INTO :RESTRCN_CNSMTNS.ITEM_QTY,:RESTRCN_CNSMTNS.ITEM_BALNCE,:RESTRCN_CNSMTNS.RI_HRMNZD_CODE,:RESTRCN_CNSMTNS.RI_MSR_NAME,:RESTRCN_CNSMTNS.RI_MSR_UNIT
 FROM ext_rstrct_rls_req_dtls ERRRD, MEASURE_UNITS IMU
 WHERE ((IMU.MSR_UNIT(+) =ERRRD.intl_msr_unit)
 AND (ERRRD.ISSUE_PORT_CD=:RESTRCN_CNSMTNS.PORT_CD )
 AND (ERRRD.REQ_ISN =:RESTRCN_CNSMTNS.REQ_ISN )
 AND (ERRRD.REQ_ITEM_SEQ =:RESTRCN_CNSMTNS.REQ_ITEM_SEQ )
 );

 EXCEPTION
 WHEN NO_DATA_FOUND THEN
 STR.DISPALERT('خطأ في بيانات صنف خطاب السلع المقيدة' ,'ERROR');
 RAISE FORM_TRIGGER_FAILURE;
 END ;

END IF;
IF :RESTRCN_CNSMTNS.RI_MSR_UNIT=:INV_MSR_UNIT THEN
 :MESURED_UNIT:= :INV_MSR_NAME;
END IF;

:ITEM_BALNCE:=:ITEM_BALNCE-:R_QTY;


 SET_RECORD_PROPERTY(:SYSTEM.TRIGGER_RECORD, 'RESTRCN_CNSMTNS', STATUS ,QUERY_STATUS);
END IF;

END;

Trigger.Name: POST-RECORD
Trigger.TriggerText:

Trigger.Name: WHEN-NEW-RECORD-INSTANCE
Trigger.TriggerText:
DECLARE
 I_QTY NUMBER;
BEGIN
 IF :RESTRCN_CNSMTNS.RES_TYPE = 1
 THEN
 :GLOBAL.RLSD_ITM_SEQ := NULL;
 ADJ_FUNS;

 SELECT INTL_ITEM_QTY
 INTO I_QTY
 FROM RLSD_ITEMS
 WHERE (PORT_CD, RLSD_HDR_ISN, RLSD_ITM_SEQ) IN
 (SELECT PORT_CD, RLSD_HDR_ISN, RLSD_ITM_SEQ
 FROM RESTRCN_CNSMTNS
 WHERE ( PORT_CD = :DCLTN_HDR.PORT_CD
 AND DCLTN_ITEM_ISN = :ITEM_ISN
 AND ROWNUM = 1))
 AND NVL (CUSTOMS_APPROVE, 0) <> 2;

 IF I_QTY > 0
 THEN
 :U_QTY := :INTL_QTY;
 ELSE
 :U_QTY := :INV_QTY;
 END IF;
 ELSIF :RESTRCN_CNSMTNS.RES_TYPE = 2
 THEN
 ---------------------------------------------------
 DECLARE
 V_I_QTY NUMBER (12, 3);
 BEGIN
 SELECT INTL_ITEM_QTY
 INTO V_I_QTY
 FROM RLSD_ITEMS_CD RI
 WHERE (PORT_CD, RLSD_HDR_ISN, RLSD_ITM_SEQ) IN
 (SELECT RLSD_PORT_CD, REQ_ISN, REQ_ITEM_SEQ
 FROM RESTRCN_CNSMTNS
 WHERE ( PORT_CD = :DCLTN_HDR.PORT_CD
 AND DCLTN_ITEM_ISN = :ITEM_ISN
 AND ROWNUM = 1))
 AND NVL (RI.CUSTOMS_APPROVE, 0) <> 2;

 I_QTY := V_I_QTY;
 END;

 -------------------------------------------------
 IF I_QTY > 0
 THEN
 :U_QTY := :INTL_QTY;
 ELSE
 :U_QTY := :INV_QTY;
 END IF;
 END IF;
EXCEPTION
 WHEN NO_DATA_FOUND
 THEN
 :U_QTY := NULL;
END;

Trigger.Name: WHEN-VALIDATE-RECORD
Trigger.TriggerText:
DECLARE
 TM_TIMER TIMER;
BEGIN
 IF :ITEM_BALNCE <= :U_QTY - NVL(:SUM_BLANCE, 0) THEN
 :R_QTY := :ITEM_BALNCE;
 :ITEM_BALNCE :=0;
 ELSIF :ITEM_BALNCE > :U_QTY - NVL(:SUM_BLANCE, 0) THEN
 :R_QTY := :U_QTY - NVL(:SUM_BLANCE, 0);
 :ITEM_BALNCE := :ITEM_BALNCE-:R_QTY;
 END IF;

 TM_TIMER := CREATE_TIMER('ADJ_BALANCE',1,REPEAT);
END;

ProgramUnit.Name: PRINT_REPORT
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 PROCEDURE PRINT_REPORT(FN In VARCHAR2, PL_ID PARAMLIST, V_REP_FRM_FLG NUMBER, V_REP_PRNT_FLG NUMBER) IS
------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 FOUND_CD BOOLEAN := FALSE;
 ROW_COUNT NUMBER := 1;


 V_MOD_ID NUMBER;
 V_MSG VARCHAR2(500);
 V_PATH VARCHAR2(200);
 V_CALLED_FORM VARCHAR2(200);
 V_MOD_NAME VARCHAR2(200);
 V_SEQ_NO NUMBER;
 V_SYS_TYPE NUMBER;
 V_FILE_NAME VARCHAR2(200);
/*
 cursor c_modudle_parameter(p_mid NUMBER)
 is select VAR_NAME ,VAR_VALUE
 from sc_port_setting
 where PORT_CD = :PARAMETER.P_CURR_PORT_CD
 AND sysobj_id = p_mid;
*/
 BEGIN
/* IF FN IS NOT NULL THEN
 WHILE ROW_COUNT <= TMPLT.FUN_ITEMS_COUNT AND NOT FOUND_CD LOOP
 IF TMPLT.FUN_ITEMS(ROW_COUNT).CD LIKE FN THEN
 FOUND_CD := TRUE;
 ELSE
 ROW_COUNT := ROW_COUNT + 1;
 END IF;
 END LOOP;

 IF FOUND_CD THEN
 IF TMPLT.FUN_ITEMS(ROW_COUNT).MID IS NOT NULL THEN
 BEGIN
 SELECT SYS_OS_FILE_NAME, SYS_ANAME, SYS_TYPE, SEQ_NO
 INTO V_FILE_NAME, V_MOD_NAME, V_SYS_TYPE, V_SEQ_NO
 FROM sc_system_objects
 WHERE SYS_TYPE = 6
 AND SYS_STATUS = 1
 AND SYSOBJ_ID = TMPLT.FUN_ITEMS(ROW_COUNT).MID;
 EXCEPTION
 WHEN NO_DATA_FOUND THEN
 STR.DISPALERT('الشاشة المطلوبة غير معرفة داخل نظام الأمن' ,'ERROR');
 END;

 IF V_FILE_NAME IS NOT NULL THEN
 ADD_PARAMETER(pl_id ,'P_USER_ID',TEXT_PARAMETER,:PARAMETER.P_USER_ID);
 ADD_PARAMETER(pl_id ,'P_USER_NAME',TEXT_PARAMETER,:PARAMETER.P_USER_NAME);
 ADD_PARAMETER(pl_id ,'P_WS_ID',TEXT_PARAMETER,:PARAMETER.P_WS_ID);
 ADD_PARAMETER(pl_id ,'P_CURR_PORT_CD',TEXT_PARAMETER,:PARAMETER.P_CURR_PORT_CD);
 ADD_PARAMETER(pl_id ,'P_PORT_TYPE',TEXT_PARAMETER,:PARAMETER.P_PORT_TYPE);
 Add_Parameter(pl_id ,'P_GROUP_CD', TEXT_PARAMETER,:PARAMETER.P_GROUP_CD);
 Add_Parameter(pl_id ,'P_USER_TYPE', TEXT_PARAMETER, :PARAMETER.P_USER_TYPE);
 Add_Parameter(pl_id ,'P_JOB_ID', TEXT_PARAMETER, :PARAMETER.P_JOB_ID);
 Add_Parameter(pl_id, 'P_CLASS_CD', TEXT_PARAMETER, :PARAMETER.P_CLASS_CD);
 ADD_PARAMETER(pl_id ,'P_MODULE_ID',TEXT_PARAMETER,TMPLT.FUN_ITEMS(ROW_COUNT).MID);
 ADD_PARAMETER(pl_id ,'P_MODULE_NAME',TEXT_PARAMETER,V_MOD_NAME);
 ADD_PARAMETER(pl_id,'P_BRKR_PORT_CD' ,TEXT_PARAMETER,:PARAMETER.P_BRKR_PORT_CD);
 ADD_PARAMETER(pl_id,'P_SHPG_AGNT_NBR',TEXT_PARAMETER,:PARAMETER.P_SHPG_AGNT_NBR);
 ADD_PARAMETER(pl_id,'P_BRKR_NBR' ,TEXT_PARAMETER,:PARAMETER.P_BRKR_NBR);
 ADD_PARAMETER(pl_id,'P_LIC_TYPE' ,TEXT_PARAMETER,:PARAMETER.P_LIC_TYPE);
 ADD_PARAMETER(pl_id,'P_BANK_CD' ,TEXT_PARAMETER,:PARAMETER.P_BANK_CD);
 ADD_PARAMETER(pl_id,'P_BANK_BRNCH_CD',TEXT_PARAMETER,:PARAMETER.P_BANK_BRNCH_CD);

 DEFAULT_VALUE('0', 'GLOBAL.SYSTEM_OBJ');
 ADD_PARAMETER(pl_id,'P_SYS_ID',TEXT_PARAMETER,:GLOBAL.SYSTEM_OBJ);
 ADD_PARAMETER(pl_id,'P_REP_NO',TEXT_PARAMETER,V_SEQ_NO);

 for i in c_modudle_parameter(TMPLT.FUN_ITEMS(ROW_COUNT).MID)
 loop
 ADD_PARAMETER(pl_id ,i.VAR_NAME,TEXT_PARAMETER,i.VAR_VALUE);
 end loop;

 V_CALLED_FORM := TMPLT.FUN_ITEMS(ROW_COUNT).PATH;
 IF SUBSTR(V_CALLED_FORM, LENGTH(V_CALLED_FORM), 1) <> '\' THEN
 V_CALLED_FORM := V_CALLED_FORM||'\';
 END IF;


 V_CALLED_FORM := V_CALLED_FORM||V_FILE_NAME;
 IF V_REP_FRM_FLG = 1 THEN
 CALL_FORM(V_CALLED_FORM,
 no_hide,
 no_replace,
 no_query_only,
 pl_id);
 ELSIF V_REP_PRNT_FLG = 1 THEN
 ADD_PARAMETER(pl_id,'DESTYPE',TEXT_PARAMETER,'PRINTER');
 Add_Parameter(pl_id,'PARAMFORM',TEXT_PARAMETER,'NO');
 ADD_PARAMETER(pl_id,'ORACLE_SHUTDOWN',TEXT_PARAMETER,'YES');
 IF ADJ_PRN.ADJ_REPORT_PRINTER(TMPLT.FUN_ITEMS(ROW_COUNT).MID, V_MSG) = TRUE THEN
 rep.Run_Product(REPORTS,V_CALLED_FORM,SYNCHRONOUS,BATCH,FILESYSTEM,pl_id,NULL);
 ELSIF V_MSG IS NOT NULL THEN
 STR.DISPALERT(V_MSG, 'ERROR');
 ELSE
 STR.DISPALERT('لا يمكن ضبط الطابعة للتقرير', 'ERROR');
 END IF;
 ELSE
 Add_Parameter(pl_id,'PARAMFORM',TEXT_PARAMETER,'NO');
 ADD_PARAMETER(pl_id,'ORACLE_SHUTDOWN',TEXT_PARAMETER,'YES');
 ADD_PARAMETER(pl_id,'MAXIMIZE',TEXT_PARAMETER,'YES');
 IF ADJ_PRN.ADJ_REPORT_PRINTER(TMPLT.FUN_ITEMS(ROW_COUNT).MID, V_MSG) = TRUE THEN
 rep.Run_Product(REPORTS,V_CALLED_FORM,SYNCHRONOUS,RUNTIME,FILESYSTEM,pl_id,NULL);
 ELSIF V_MSG IS NOT NULL THEN
 STR.DISPALERT(V_MSG, 'ERROR');
 ELSE
 STR.DISPALERT('لا يمكن ضبط الطابعة للتقرير', 'ERROR');
 END IF;
 END IF;
 ELSE
 STR.DISPALERT('مسار ملف التقرير غير معرفة داخل نظام الأمن' ,'ERROR');
 END IF;
 ELSE
 STR.DISPALERT('ملف التقرير غير معرف داخل نظام الأمن' ,'ERROR');
 END IF;
 END IF;
 END IF;*/

 NIB.PRINT_REPORT(FN,PL_ID,V_REP_FRM_FLG,V_REP_PRNT_FLG);
 END PRINT_REPORT;

ProgramUnit.Name: EXECUTE_FUNCTION
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 PROCEDURE Execute_Function(FN In VARCHAR2) IS
------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 FOUND_CD BOOLEAN := FALSE;
 ROW_COUNT NUMBER := 1;
 CD_TITLE VARCHAR2(200);
 RET NUMBER;
 V_MSG VARCHAR2(2000);

 V_MOD_ID NUMBER;
 V_PATH VARCHAR2(200);
 pl_id ParamList;
 V_CALLED_FORM VARCHAR2(200);
 V_MOD_NAME VARCHAR2(200);
 V_SEQ_NO NUMBER;
 V_SYS_TYPE NUMBER;
 V_FILE_NAME VARCHAR2(200);

 cursor c_modudle_parameter(p_mid NUMBER)
 is select VAR_NAME ,VAR_VALUE
 from sc_port_setting
 where PORT_CD = :PARAMETER.P_CURR_PORT_CD -- NALSALEH CENTRALIZED PROJECT
 AND sysobj_id = p_mid;

 BEGIN
 IF FN IS NOT NULL THEN
 SET_VIEW_PROPERTY('LSIDE', VISIBLE, PROPERTY_FALSE);
 CD_TITLE := NAME_IN(FN);

 WHILE ROW_COUNT <= TMPLT.FUN_ITEMS_COUNT AND NOT FOUND_CD LOOP
 IF TMPLT.FUN_ITEMS(ROW_COUNT).TITLE LIKE CD_TITLE AND TMPLT.FUN_ITEMS(ROW_COUNT).ACT = 1 THEN
 FOUND_CD := TRUE;
 ELSE
 ROW_COUNT := ROW_COUNT + 1;
 END IF;

 END LOOP;

 IF FOUND_CD THEN
 IF TMPLT.FUN_ITEMS(ROW_COUNT).MID IS NOT NULL THEN
 BEGIN
 SELECT SYS_OS_FILE_NAME, SYS_ANAME, SYS_TYPE, SEQ_NO
 INTO V_FILE_NAME, V_MOD_NAME, V_SYS_TYPE, V_SEQ_NO
 FROM sc_system_objects
 WHERE SYS_TYPE IN (5,6)
 AND SYS_STATUS = 1
 AND SYSOBJ_ID = TMPLT.FUN_ITEMS(ROW_COUNT).MID;
 EXCEPTION
 WHEN NO_DATA_FOUND THEN
 STR.DISPALERT('الشاشة المطلوبة غير معرفة داخل نظام الأمن او انها غير فعالة' ,'ERROR');
 END;

 IF V_FILE_NAME IS NOT NULL THEN
 pl_id := Get_Parameter_List('TMPLT_MOD_CALL');
 IF Id_Null(pl_id) THEN
 pl_id := Create_Parameter_List('TMPLT_MOD_CALL');
 IF Id_Null(pl_id) THEN
 ret := Str.Dispalert('Error creating parameter list TMPLT_MOD_CALL IN TEMPLATE ', 'SYSTEM_ERROR');
 RAISE Form_Trigger_Failure;
 END IF;

 ADD_PARAMETER(pl_id ,'P_USER_ID',TEXT_PARAMETER,:PARAMETER.P_USER_ID);
 ADD_PARAMETER(pl_id ,'P_USER_NAME',TEXT_PARAMETER,:PARAMETER.P_USER_NAME);
 ADD_PARAMETER(pl_id ,'P_WS_ID',TEXT_PARAMETER,:PARAMETER.P_WS_ID);
 ADD_PARAMETER(pl_id ,'P_CURR_PORT_CD',TEXT_PARAMETER,:PARAMETER.P_CURR_PORT_CD);
 ADD_PARAMETER(pl_id ,'P_PORT_TYPE',TEXT_PARAMETER,:PARAMETER.P_PORT_TYPE);
 Add_Parameter(pl_id ,'P_GROUP_CD', TEXT_PARAMETER,:PARAMETER.P_GROUP_CD);
 Add_Parameter(pl_id ,'P_USER_TYPE', TEXT_PARAMETER, :PARAMETER.P_USER_TYPE);
 Add_Parameter(pl_id ,'P_JOB_ID', TEXT_PARAMETER, :PARAMETER.P_JOB_ID);
 Add_Parameter(pl_id, 'P_CLASS_CD', TEXT_PARAMETER, :PARAMETER.P_CLASS_CD);
 ADD_PARAMETER(pl_id ,'P_MODULE_ID',TEXT_PARAMETER,TMPLT.FUN_ITEMS(ROW_COUNT).MID);
 ADD_PARAMETER(pl_id ,'P_MODULE_NAME',TEXT_PARAMETER,V_MOD_NAME);
 ADD_PARAMETER(pl_id,'P_BRKR_PORT_CD' ,TEXT_PARAMETER,:PARAMETER.P_BRKR_PORT_CD);
 ADD_PARAMETER(pl_id,'P_SHPG_AGNT_NBR',TEXT_PARAMETER,:PARAMETER.P_SHPG_AGNT_NBR);
 ADD_PARAMETER(pl_id,'P_BRKR_NBR' ,TEXT_PARAMETER,:PARAMETER.P_BRKR_NBR);
 ADD_PARAMETER(pl_id,'P_LIC_TYPE' ,TEXT_PARAMETER,:PARAMETER.P_LIC_TYPE);
 ADD_PARAMETER(pl_id,'P_BANK_CD' ,TEXT_PARAMETER,:PARAMETER.P_BANK_CD);
 ADD_PARAMETER(pl_id,'P_BANK_BRNCH_CD',TEXT_PARAMETER,:PARAMETER.P_BANK_BRNCH_CD);
 for i in c_modudle_parameter(TMPLT.FUN_ITEMS(ROW_COUNT).MID)
 loop
 ADD_PARAMETER(pl_id ,i.VAR_NAME,TEXT_PARAMETER,i.VAR_VALUE);
 end loop;

 EXEC_FUNS(TMPLT.FUN_ITEMS(ROW_COUNT).CD);
 pl_id := Get_Parameter_List('TMPLT_MOD_CALL');
 IF NOT Id_Null(pl_id) THEN
 V_CALLED_FORM := TMPLT.FUN_ITEMS(ROW_COUNT).PATH;
 IF SUBSTR(V_CALLED_FORM, LENGTH(V_CALLED_FORM), 1) <> '\' THEN
 V_CALLED_FORM := V_CALLED_FORM||'\';
 END IF;


 V_CALLED_FORM := V_CALLED_FORM||V_FILE_NAME;
 IF V_SYS_TYPE = 5 THEN
 CALL_FORM(V_CALLED_FORM,
 no_hide,
 no_replace,
 no_query_only,
 pl_id);
 ELSE
 DEFAULT_VALUE('0', 'GLOBAL.SYSTEM_OBJ');
 ADD_PARAMETER(pl_id,'P_SYS_ID',TEXT_PARAMETER,:GLOBAL.SYSTEM_OBJ);
 ADD_PARAMETER(pl_id,'P_REP_NO',TEXT_PARAMETER,V_SEQ_NO);
 ADD_PARAMETER(pl_id,'P_REPORT_NO',TEXT_PARAMETER,:GLOBAL.SYSTEM_OBJ ||'-'||V_SEQ_NO);
 IF TMPLT.FUN_ITEMS(ROW_COUNT).FORM_FLAG = 1 THEN
 CALL_FORM(V_CALLED_FORM,
 no_hide,
 no_replace,
 no_query_only,
 pl_id);
 ELSIF TMPLT.FUN_ITEMS(ROW_COUNT).PRNT_FLAG = 1 THEN
 ADD_PARAMETER(pl_id,'DESTYPE',TEXT_PARAMETER,'PRINTER');
 Add_Parameter(pl_id,'PARAMFORM',TEXT_PARAMETER,'NO');
 ADD_PARAMETER(pl_id,'ORACLE_SHUTDOWN',TEXT_PARAMETER,'YES');

 IF ADJ_PRN.ADJ_REPORT_PRINTER(TMPLT.FUN_ITEMS(ROW_COUNT).MID, V_MSG) = TRUE THEN
 REP.Run_Product(REPORTS,V_CALLED_FORM,SYNCHRONOUS,BATCH,FILESYSTEM,pl_id,NULL);
 ELSIF V_MSG IS NOT NULL THEN
 STR.DISPALERT(V_MSG, 'ERROR');
 ELSE
 STR.DISPALERT('لا يمكن ضبط الطابعة للتقرير', 'ERROR');
 END IF;
 ELSE
 Add_Parameter(pl_id,'PARAMFORM',TEXT_PARAMETER,'NO');
 ADD_PARAMETER(pl_id,'ORACLE_SHUTDOWN',TEXT_PARAMETER,'YES');
 ADD_PARAMETER(pl_id,'MAXIMIZE',TEXT_PARAMETER,'YES');
 IF ADJ_PRN.ADJ_REPORT_PRINTER(TMPLT.FUN_ITEMS(ROW_COUNT).MID, V_MSG) = TRUE THEN
 REP.Run_Product(REPORTS,V_CALLED_FORM,SYNCHRONOUS,RUNTIME,FILESYSTEM,pl_id,NULL);
 ELSIF V_MSG IS NOT NULL THEN
 STR.DISPALERT(V_MSG, 'ERROR');
 ELSE
 STR.DISPALERT('لا يمكن ضبط الطابعة للتقرير', 'ERROR');
 END IF;

 END IF;
 END IF;

 :PARAMETER.P_CTRL_LAST_EXEC_CD := TMPLT.FUN_ITEMS(ROW_COUNT).CD;
 EXEC_FUNS('MOD_CALL_BACK');
 :PARAMETER.P_CTRL_LAST_EXEC_CD := NULL;
 Destroy_Parameter_List(pl_id);
 END IF;
 ELSE
 ret := Str.DispAlert('Parameter list '||'TMPLT_MOD_CALL'||' already exists!','INFORMATION');
 RAISE Form_Trigger_Failure;
 END IF;
 ELSE
 RET := STR.DISPALERT('الشاشة المطلوبة غير معرفة داخل نظام الأمن او انها غير فعالة' ,'ERROR');
 END IF;
 ELSE
 EXEC_FUNS(TMPLT.FUN_ITEMS(ROW_COUNT).CD);
 :PARAMETER.P_CTRL_LAST_EXEC_CD := TMPLT.FUN_ITEMS(ROW_COUNT).CD;
 EXEC_FUNS('MOD_CALL_BACK');
 :PARAMETER.P_CTRL_LAST_EXEC_CD := NULL;
 END IF;
 ELSE
 RET := STR.DISPALERT('خطأ داخلي في أكواد الوظائف - إتصل بالمساندة الفنية' ,'ERROR');
 END IF;
 END IF;
 END Execute_Function;

ProgramUnit.Name: CHECK_EDI_MSG_LOV
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
/* Formatted on 14/05/2026 03:54:50 ? (QP5 v5.287) */
FUNCTION CHECK_EDI_MSG_LOV
 RETURN BOOLEAN
IS
 V_COUNT NUMBER;
 V_RETURN BOOLEAN;
BEGIN
 /*
 SELECT COUNT(*) INTO V_COUNT
 FROM SC_PORT_SETTING
 WHERE PORT_CD = :PARAMETER.P_CURR_PORT_CD -- NALSALEH CENTRALIZED PROJECT
 AND SYSOBJ_ID = 30
 AND VAR_NAME = 'EDIMSG1220_LOV'
 AND VAR_VALUE > 0
 ;

 IF V_COUNT > 0 THEN

ProgramUnit.Name: CGDV$POPULATE_DYNAMIC_LISTS
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
/* CGDV$POPULATE_DYNAMIC_LISTS */
PROCEDURE CGDV$POPULATE_DYNAMIC_LISTS IS
/* Read each lists values from its record group and populate the list */
 temp NUMBER; /* Return value of populate_group call */
 rg_id RECORDGROUP; /* Return value of populate_group call */
BEGIN
 rg_id := create_group_from_query('CGDV$DLRG',
 'SELECT RV_LOW_VALUE, RV_LOW_VALUE '||
 'FROM CG_REF_CODES '||
 'WHERE RV_DOMAIN = ''DCLTN_PMT_METHOD'' '||
 'ORDER BY 2');
 temp := populate_group(rg_id);
 populate_list('DCLTN_HDR.PMT_METHOD', rg_id);
 delete_group(rg_id);

 rg_id := create_group_from_query('CGDV$DLRG',
 'SELECT RV_MEANING, RV_LOW_VALUE '||
 'FROM CG_REF_CODES '||
 'WHERE RV_DOMAIN = ''RESTRCN_CONFIRM'' '||
 'ORDER BY 2');
 temp := populate_group(rg_id);
 populate_list('RESTRCN_CNSMTNS.APRVD', rg_id);
 delete_group(rg_id);

END;

ProgramUnit.Name: CGTE$CHECK_CONSTRAINT_VIO
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
/* CGTE$CHECK_CONSTRAINT_VIO */
FUNCTION CGTE$CHECK_CONSTRAINT_VIO(
 P_SERVER_ERR IN NUMBER /* Server error message */
 ,P_SERVER_MSG IN VARCHAR2) /* Server error number */
RETURN BOOLEAN IS
/* Check and report Primary/Unique Key, Check Constraint and User */
/* Defined Constraint violations */
 constraint_name VARCHAR2(61); /* Violated constraint */
BEGIN
 /* Check if the error code is one we are interested in */
 IF ( NOT (P_SERVER_ERR IN (1, 2290) OR
 (P_SERVER_ERR >= 20000 AND P_SERVER_ERR <= 20999) ) )
 THEN
 RETURN( FALSE );
 END IF;

 /* Deal with user defined errors */
 IF (P_SERVER_ERR >= 20000 AND P_SERVER_ERR <= 20999) THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH(''||CGTE$STRIP_FIRST_ERROR(P_SERVER_MSG), 'E', 'OFG', 0);
 RETURN( TRUE );
 END IF;

 /* Deal with Primary/Unique Key and Check Constraint violations */
 constraint_name := CGTE$STRIP_CONSTRAINT(P_SERVER_MSG);
 IF (P_SERVER_ERR = 1) THEN
 IF (constraint_name = 'DCLTN_PK') THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH('هذا السجل موجود بالفعل - أعد إدخال بيانات جديدة', 'E', 'OFG', 0);
 ELSIF (constraint_name = 'DCLTN_STATUS_PK') THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH('هذا السجل موجود بالفعل - أعد إدخال بيانات جديدة', 'E', 'OFG', 0);
 ELSIF (constraint_name = 'DCLTNT_PK') THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH('هذا السجل موجود بالفعل - أعد إدخال بيانات جديدة', 'E', 'OFG', 0);
 ELSIF (constraint_name = 'SDP_PK') THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH(Des$Form_errors.MSGGETTEXT(6, 'Row exists already with same <p1>', 'رمز الجمرك' ), 'E', 'OFG', 6);
 ELSIF (constraint_name = 'IMP_PK') THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH('هذا السجل مدخل سابقاً - أعد ادخال البيانات', 'E', 'OFG', 0);
 ELSIF (constraint_name = 'IMP_BUSID_UK') THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH('هذا السجل مدخل سابقاً - أعد ادخال البيانات', 'E', 'OFG', 0);
 ELSIF (constraint_name = 'STMT_IT_PK') THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH('هذا السجل موجود بالفعل - أعد إدخال بيانات جديدة', 'E', 'OFG', 0);
 ELSIF (constraint_name = 'DCLTN_IT_UK') THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH(Des$Form_errors.MSGGETTEXT(6, 'Row exists already with same <p1>', 'PORT_CD,ITEM_ISN,FINAL_TARIFF_CD' ), 'E', 'OFG', 6);
 ELSIF (constraint_name = 'MU_PK') THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH(Des$Form_errors.MSGGETTEXT(6, 'Row exists already with same <p1>', 'وحدة القياس' ), 'E', 'OFG', 6);
 ELSIF (constraint_name = 'CTRY_PK') THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH(Des$Form_errors.MSGGETTEXT(6, 'Row exists already with same <p1>', 'رمز الدولة' ), 'E', 'OFG', 6);
 ELSIF (constraint_name = 'IMU_PK') THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH(Des$Form_errors.MSGGETTEXT(6, 'Row exists already with same <p1>', 'رمز وحدة القياس الدولية' ), 'E', 'OFG', 6);
 ELSIF (constraint_name = 'TRFD_PK') THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH(Des$Form_errors.MSGGETTEXT(6, 'Row exists already with same <p1>', 'EFF_DATE,HRMNZD_CODE' ), 'E', 'OFG', 6);
 ELSIF (constraint_name = 'HT_PK') THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH(Des$Form_errors.MSGGETTEXT(6, 'Row exists already with same <p1>', 'البند المنسق' ), 'E', 'OFG', 6);
 ELSIF (constraint_name = 'RCN_PK') THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH('هذا السجل موجود بالفعل - أعد إدخال بيانات جديدة', 'E', 'OFG', 0);
 ELSE
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH(P_SERVER_MSG, 'I', 'OFG', 0);
 END IF;
 ELSIF (P_SERVER_ERR = 2290) THEN
 IF (constraint_name = 'VALID_DATE_NUMBER') THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH('خطأ في عملية ترقيم البيان الجمركي - يجب وجود رقم وتاريخ في نفس الوقت', 'E', 'OFG', 0);
 Des$Form_errors.RAISE_FAILURE;
 ELSIF (constraint_name = 'REF_EXISTING_DATA_CHK') THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH('يجب ربط صنف البيان بصنف خطاب سلع مقيدة أو خطاب حسم سلع مقيدة', 'E', 'OFG', 0);
 Des$Form_errors.RAISE_FAILURE;
 ELSE
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH(P_SERVER_MSG, 'I', 'OFG', 0);
 END IF;
 END IF;
 RETURN( TRUE );
END;

ProgramUnit.Name: CGBS$TOGGLE
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
/* CGBS$TOGGLE */
PROCEDURE CGBS$TOGGLE(
 P_QUERY_MODE IN OUT VARCHAR2) IS /* Query Mode */
/* Toggle query mode between BSMON and BSMOFF, set all query mode items, */
/* display query mode message, set the relations and ensure that the */
/* canvas is coordinated. */
BEGIN
 /* Toggle the mode */
 IF (P_QUERY_MODE != 'A') THEN
 P_QUERY_MODE := 'A';
 ELSE
 P_QUERY_MODE := 'A';
 END IF;
 /* Set all the items */
 CGBS$SET_QUERY_MODE( P_QUERY_MODE );
 /* Display query mode messages */
 CGBS$MESSAGE_QUERY_MODE( P_QUERY_MODE );
 /* Set the relations */
 CGBS$.SET_RELATIONS( P_QUERY_MODE );
 /* If the query mode is AutoQuery, coordinate outstanding blocks */
 IF (P_QUERY_MODE = 'A') THEN
 CGBS$.COORD_VISIBLE_BLKS( :SYSTEM.CURSOR_BLOCK );
 END IF;
END;

ProgramUnit.Name: EXEC_FUNS
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE EXEC_FUNS(CD VARCHAR2) IS
 RET NUMBER;
 pl_id ParamList;
 pl_name VARCHAR2(100) := 'TMPLT_MOD_CALL';
BEGIN
 IF CD = 'CD_01080' THEN
 RET := STR.DispALERT('سيتم إعتماد فسح السلعة المقيدة - هل ترغب في إستكمال الإعتماد؟', 'CONFIRM');
 IF Ret = alert_button1 THEN
 IF NOT ACTIVITY.ADD_ACTIVITY(21, 7, 3, :RESTRCN_CNSMTNS.PORT_CD||'!'||:RESTRCN_CNSMTNS.DCLTN_ITEM_ISN||'!'||:RESTRCN_CNSMTNS.RLS_SEQ) THEN
 RAISE FORM_TRIGGER_FAILURE;
 END IF;

 APPROVE_RELEASE;
 END IF;

 ELSIF CD = 'CD_01090' THEN
 RET := STR.DispALERT('سيتم إلغاء إعتماد فسح السلعة المقيدة - هل ترغب في إستكمال إلغاء الإعتماد؟', 'CONFIRM');
 IF Ret = alert_button1 THEN

 IF NOT ACTIVITY.ADD_ACTIVITY(21, 7, 4, :RESTRCN_CNSMTNS.PORT_CD||'!'||:RESTRCN_CNSMTNS.DCLTN_ITEM_ISN||'!'||:RESTRCN_CNSMTNS.RLS_SEQ) THEN
 RAISE FORM_TRIGGER_FAILURE;
 END IF;

 CANCEL_RELEASE;
 END IF;
 ELSIF CD = 'CD_02180' THEN

 DECLARE

 V_ATHRTY_CD NUMBER;
 V_ATHRTY_SUB_CD NUMBER;
 V_ATHRTY_SEQ NUMBER;

 BEGIN

 SELECT sign_pics.ATHRTY_CD,sign_pics.ATHRTY_SUB_CD,sign_pics.ATHRTY_SEQ
 INTO V_ATHRTY_CD,V_ATHRTY_SUB_CD ,V_ATHRTY_SEQ
 FROM rlsd_hdrs, sign_pics
 WHERE
 rlsd_hdrs.rlsd_hdr_isn = :RESTRCN_CNSMTNS.rlsd_hdr_isn
 AND rlsd_hdrs.port_cd = :RESTRCN_CNSMTNS.port_cd
 AND sign_pics.athrty_CD = rlsd_hdrs.rac_athrty_cd
 AND sign_pics.athrty_sub_cd = rlsd_hdrs.rac_athrty_sub_cd
 AND sign_pics.athrty_seq = rlsd_hdrs.athrty_seq
 AND ROWNUM<=1
 ;
 pl_id := Get_Parameter_List(pl_name);
 IF NOT Id_Null(pl_id) THEN
 add_parameter(pl_id,'P_ATHRTY_CD',text_parameter,V_ATHRTY_CD);
 add_parameter(pl_id,'P_ATHRTY_SUB_CD',text_parameter,V_ATHRTY_SUB_CD);
 add_parameter(pl_id,'P_ATHRTY_SEQ',text_parameter,V_ATHRTY_SEQ);
 add_parameter(pl_id,'P_PERSON_SEQ',text_parameter,NULL);
 add_parameter(pl_id,'P_SCAN_MODE',text_parameter,0);
 ELSE
 ret := Str.DispAlert('Parameter list '||pl_name||' NOT EXIST! INTERNAL ERROR','INFORMATION');
 TERMINATE_FUN;
 END IF;
 EXCEPTION WHEN NO_DATA_FOUND THEN
 STR.DISPALERT('لايوجد توقيع مربوط على خطاب السلع المقيدة','INFORMATION');

 END;

 END IF;

END;

ProgramUnit.Name: ENB_DIS_EXT_LTR
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE ENB_DIS_EXT_LTR IS
BEGIN
SET_ITEM_PROPERTY('RLSD_REQ_ISN', ENABLED , PROPERTY_TRUE);

-- --> 14/07/2009 AHMED A-MONIM Create External Request EXT_RSTRCT_RLS_REQS , EXT_RSTRCT_RLS_REQ_DTLS
PROCEDURE CR_EXT_RLS_REQ IS

 R_COUNT NUMBER;

--
 V_ISSUE_PORT_CD NUMBER(3);
 V_REQ_ISN NUMBER(10);
 V_REQ_LETR_NBR NUMBER(6);

 V_REQ_STA_CD NUMBER(1);

 V_DCLTN_NBR NUMBER(10);
 V_DCLTN_DT DATE;
 V_DCLTN_ISN NUMBER(10);
 V_REQ_LETR_DATE DATE;
 V_RLS_LTR_PORT_CD NUMBER(3);
 V_HQ_IMPR_NBR NUMBER(10);
 V_HQ_BNFCRY_NBR NUMBER(10);
 V_RSTRCT_DCLTN_TYPE NUMBER(2);
--
 V_DTL_ISSUE_PORT_CD NUMBER(3);
 V_DTL_REQ_ISN NUMBER(10);
 V_DTL_REQ_ITEM_SEQ NUMBER(3);
 V_DTL_REQ_QTY NUMBER(16,4);
 V_DTL_ACTL_AVLBL_QTY NUMBER(16,4);
 V_DTL_ITEM_RMRKS VARCHAR2(100);
 V_DTL_REQ_ITEM_STA_CD NUMBER(1);

 V_DTL_RLSD_ITEM_SEQ NUMBER(4);
 V_DTL_INTL_MSR_UNIT NUMBER(3);
 V_DTL_RAC_ATHRTY_CD NUMBER(3);
 V_DTL_RAC_ATHRTY_SUB_CD NUMBER(3);

 -- Yhelmy CRQ22081 Start
 /*SELECT IM.HQ_IMPR_NBR
 INTO V_HQ_IMPR_NBR
 FROM IMPORTERS IM

*/

V_HQ_IMPR_NBR := :DCLTN_HDR.IMPR_NBR ;

-- Yhelmy CRQ22081 END

 V_ISSUE_PORT_CD := :DCLTN_ITEMS.PORT_CD;
 V_RLS_LTR_PORT_CD := :RLSD_PORT_CD;
 V_HQ_BNFCRY_NBR := V_HQ_IMPR_NBR;


 SELECT LOC_NBR, LOC_DATE, RAC_ATHRTY_CD, RAC_ATHRTY_SUB_CD, REMARKS
 INTO :RESTRCN_CNSMTNS.LOC_NBR,:RESTRCN_CNSMTNS.LOC_DATE,
 :RESTRCN_CNSMTNS.RAC_ATHRTY_CD,:RESTRCN_CNSMTNS.RAC_ATHRTY_SUB_CD,V_REQ_RMRKS
 FROM RLSD_HDRS_HQ
 WHERE PORT_CD = :RLSD_PORT_CD AND
--05082009 RLSD_HDR_ISN = :RLSD_REQ_ISN ;
 RLSD_HDR_ISN = :EXT_REQ_ISN ;
 V_APRVL_TIME := SYSDATE;
 V_APRVL_USR_ID := :PARAMETER.P_USER_ID;
 V_APRVL_USR_NAME := :PARAMETER.P_USER_NAME;
 V_APRVL_DT := HIJDATE.CUR_HIJ_DATE;
 V_DCLTN_PORT_CD := :DCLTN_ITEMS.PORT_CD;
 V_DCLTN_NBR := :DCLTN_HDR.DCLTN_NBR;
 V_DCLTN_DT := :DCLTN_HDR.DCLTN_DT;
 V_DCLTN_ISN := :DCLTN_ITEMS.DCLTN_ISN;
 V_REQ_LETR_DATE := HIJDATE.CUR_HIJ_DATE;
 V_RSTRCT_DCLTN_TYPE := 1;
 V_REQ_STA_CD := 3;

SELECT MAX(REQ_ISN), COUNT(*)
 INTO V_REQ_ISN, R_COUNT
 FROM EXT_RSTRCT_RLS_REQS
 WHERE ISSUE_PORT_CD = :DCLTN_ITEMS.PORT_CD AND
 DCLTN_ISN = :DCLTN_ITEMS.DCLTN_ISN AND
-- --> 30/05/2009 AHMED A-MONIM RLSD_LTR_PORT_CD MUST BE EQUAL :RLSD_PORT_CD
 RLS_LTR_PORT_CD = :RLSD_PORT_CD AND
-- --< 30/05/2009 AHMED A-MONIM RLSD_LTR_PORT_CD MUST BE EQUAL :RLSD_PORT_CD
 (HQ_BNFCRY_NBR = V_HQ_IMPR_NBR OR HQ_IMPR_NBR = V_HQ_IMPR_NBR) AND
 REQ_STA_CD != 1 ;
IF R_COUNT = 0
THEN
BEGIN

 --SELECT EXT_RSTRCT_REQ_SEQ.NEXTVAL INTO V_REQ_ISN FROM SYS.DUAL;
 
 SELECT GNRL.GET_SEQUENCE_VALUE (:parameter.p_curr_PORT_CD,'EXT_RSTRCT_REQ_SEQ') INTO V_REQ_ISN FROM DUAL;
 

 SELECT NVL(MAX(REQ_LETR_NBR),0)+1
 INTO V_REQ_LETR_NBR
 FROM EXT_RSTRCT_RLS_REQS
 WHERE ISSUE_PORT_CD = :DCLTN_ITEMS.PORT_CD ;
 V_REQ_LETR_NBR_SUB := NULL;

BEGIN
INSERT INTO EXT_RSTRCT_RLS_REQS (
 ISSUE_PORT_CD
 ,REQ_ISN
 ,REQ_LETR_NBR
 ,REQ_LETR_NBR_SUB
 ,REQ_STA_CD
 ,REQ_RMRKS
 ,APRVL_TIME
 ,APRVL_USR_ID
 ,APRVL_USR_NAME
 ,APRVL_DT
 ,DCLTN_PORT_CD
 ,DCLTN_NBR
 ,DCLTN_DT
 ,DCLTN_ISN
 ,REQ_LETR_DATE
 ,RLS_LTR_PORT_CD
 ,HQ_IMPR_NBR
 ,HQ_BNFCRY_NBR
 ,RSTRCT_DCLTN_TYPE )
 VALUES (
 V_ISSUE_PORT_CD
 ,V_REQ_ISN
 ,V_REQ_LETR_NBR
 ,V_REQ_LETR_NBR_SUB
 ,V_REQ_STA_CD
 ,V_REQ_RMRKS
 ,V_APRVL_TIME
 ,V_APRVL_USR_ID
 ,V_APRVL_USR_NAME
 ,V_APRVL_DT
 ,V_DCLTN_PORT_CD
 ,V_DCLTN_NBR
 ,V_DCLTN_DT
 ,V_DCLTN_ISN
 ,V_REQ_LETR_DATE
 ,V_RLS_LTR_PORT_CD
 ,V_HQ_IMPR_NBR
 ,V_HQ_BNFCRY_NBR
 ,V_RSTRCT_DCLTN_TYPE ) ;
END;
DECLARE
 actv_ret BOOLEAN;
 PKEY VARCHAR2(30);
BEGIN
 PKEY := V_ISSUE_PORT_CD || '!' || V_REQ_ISN ;
 actv_ret := activity.ADD_ACTIVITY(17, 4, 1, PKEY);
 IF actv_ret = FALSE THEN
 RAISE form_trigger_failure;
 END IF;
END;

END;
END IF;
 V_DTL_ISSUE_PORT_CD := V_ISSUE_PORT_CD ;
 V_DTL_REQ_ISN := V_REQ_ISN ;
 SELECT NVL(MAX(ERRRD.REQ_ITEM_SEQ),0)+1
 INTO V_DTL_REQ_ITEM_SEQ
 FROM EXT_RSTRCT_RLS_REQ_DTLS ERRRD,EXT_RSTRCT_RLS_REQS ERRR
 WHERE ERRRD.ISSUE_PORT_CD=ERRR.ISSUE_PORT_CD AND
 ERRRD.REQ_ISN=ERRRD.REQ_ISN AND
 ERRRD.ISSUE_PORT_CD = V_DTL_ISSUE_PORT_CD AND
 ERRRD.REQ_ISN = V_DTL_REQ_ISN ;
-- V_DTL_REQ_QTY := :DCLTN_ITEMS.QTY;
 V_DTL_ACTL_AVLBL_QTY := :RESTRCN_CNSMTNS.R_QTY;
 V_DTL_REQ_QTY := :RESTRCN_CNSMTNS.R_QTY;
-- V_DTL_ACTL_AVLBL_QTY := :RESTRCN_CNSMTNS.ITEM_BALNCE;
 -- V_DTL_ITEM_RMRKS ;
 V_DTL_REQ_ITEM_STA_CD := 3;

 V_DTL_RLSD_LOC_DATE := :RESTRCN_CNSMTNS.LOC_DATE;
 V_DTL_HRMNZD_CODE := :DCLTN_ITEMS.FINAL_TARIFF_CD;
 V_DTL_EXT_DCLTN_ITEM_SEQ := :DCLTN_ITEMS.ITEM_SEQ;
-- --> 11/10/2010 AHMED A-MONIM To get DTL.RLSD_ITM_SEQ for Delete (when many items in letter)
-- V_DTL_RLSD_ITEM_SEQ := :DCLTN_ITEMS.ITEM_SEQ;
 V_DTL_RLSD_ITEM_SEQ := :RESTRCN_CNSMTNS.RLSD_REQ_SEQ;
 V_DTL_INTL_MSR_UNIT := :DCLTN_ITEMS.INV_MSR_UNIT;
 V_DTL_RAC_ATHRTY_CD := :RESTRCN_CNSMTNS.RAC_ATHRTY_CD;
 V_DTL_RAC_ATHRTY_SUB_CD := :RESTRCN_CNSMTNS.RAC_ATHRTY_SUB_CD;
 V_DTL_RLS_LTR_PORT_CD := V_RLS_LTR_PORT_CD;
BEGIN
INSERT INTO EXT_RSTRCT_RLS_REQ_DTLS (
 ISSUE_PORT_CD
 ,REQ_ISN
 ,REQ_ITEM_SEQ
 ,REQ_QTY

 ,ITEM_RMRKS

 ,RLSD_LOC_NBR
 ,RLSD_LOC_DATE
 ,HRMNZD_CODE
 ,EXT_DCLTN_ITEM_SEQ
 ,RLSD_ITEM_SEQ
 ,INTL_MSR_UNIT

 ,RLS_LTR_PORT_CD )

 ,V_DTL_REQ_QTY
 ,V_DTL_ACTL_AVLBL_QTY

 ,V_DTL_REQ_ITEM_STA_CD
 ,V_DTL_RLSD_LOC_NBR
 ,V_DTL_RLSD_LOC_DATE
 ,V_DTL_HRMNZD_CODE
 ,V_DTL_EXT_DCLTN_ITEM_SEQ
 ,V_DTL_RLSD_ITEM_SEQ
 ,V_DTL_INTL_MSR_UNIT
 ,V_DTL_RAC_ATHRTY_CD
 ,V_DTL_RAC_ATHRTY_SUB_CD
 ,V_DTL_RLS_LTR_PORT_CD ) ;
END;

:RESTRCN_CNSMTNS.REQ_ISN := V_REQ_ISN;

:RESTRCN_CNSMTNS.REQ_ITEM_SEQ := V_DTL_REQ_ITEM_SEQ;






DECLARE
 actv_ret BOOLEAN;
 PKEY VARCHAR2(30);
BEGIN
 PKEY := V_ISSUE_PORT_CD || '!' || V_REQ_ISN || '!' || V_DTL_REQ_ITEM_SEQ ;
 actv_ret := activity.ADD_ACTIVITY(17, 5, 1, PKEY);
 IF actv_ret = FALSE THEN

ProgramUnit.Name: CHK_VALID_LTR
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
/* DEVELOPER :KAMEL ELSAYED
 DATE :25/10/2007
 MODIFICATION :DEVLOPED FORM TO ACCEPT THE REQUEST EXTERNAL CLERN. LETTER FROM ANOTHER PORT*/

PROCEDURE CHK_VALID_LTR IS
R_COUNT NUMBER;
V_CHECK_DT DATE;
V_CHK_DCLN_TYPE NUMBER;
V_HQ_IMPR_NBR NUMBER;
V_RLSD_PORT_CD NUMBER;

 BEGIN
---->>>>>------------------------------------------------------------------------------
IF :RESTRCN_CNSMTNS.RES_TYPE=1 THEN
IF :DCLTN_HDR.DCLTN_DT IS NOT NULL THEN
 V_CHECK_DT := :DCLTN_HDR.DCLTN_DT;
ELSE
 V_CHECK_DT := HIJDATE.Cur_Hij_Date;
END IF;

-----------------------------------------
IF :DCLTN_TYPE_CD IN (1,2) THEN
 V_CHK_DCLN_TYPE := 1 ;
ELSIF :DCLTN_TYPE_CD IN (3,4,5,6) THEN
 V_CHK_DCLN_TYPE := 2 ;
END IF;
------------------------------------------------------------------------------
BEGIN
R_COUNT := 0;
SELECT COUNT(*)
INTO R_COUNT
FROM RLSD_HDRS
WHERE RLSD_HDRS.LOC_STATUS NOT IN(2,4)
AND NVL(LOC_STAGE_CODE,0) = V_CHK_DCLN_TYPE
AND (RLSD_HDRS.BNFCRY_NBR = :GLOBAL.IMPR_NBR OR RLSD_HDRS.IMPR_NBR = :GLOBAL.IMPR_NBR)
AND RLSD_HDR_ISN=:RESTRCN_CNSMTNS.RLSD_REQ_ISN
AND RLSD_HDRS.LOC_EXP_DATE >= V_CHECK_DT
AND ( (NVL(RLSD_HDRS.LOC_EFF_EXP_FLAG,0) = 0) OR (RLSD_HDRS.LOC_EFF_EXP_FLAG = 1 AND RLSD_HDRS.LOC_EFF_DATE <= V_CHECK_DT))
;
EXCEPTION
 WHEN OTHERS THEN NULL;
END;
------------------------------------------------------------------------------

IF R_COUNT = 0
 THEN
 ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 BEGIN
 R_COUNT := 0;
 SELECT COUNT(*)
 INTO R_COUNT
 FROM RLSD_HDRS
 WHERE RLSD_HDRS.LOC_STATUS NOT IN(2,4)
 AND NVL(LOC_STAGE_CODE,0) = V_CHK_DCLN_TYPE
 AND (RLSD_HDRS.BNFCRY_NBR = :GLOBAL.IMPR_NBR OR RLSD_HDRS.IMPR_NBR = :GLOBAL.IMPR_NBR)
 AND RLSD_HDR_ISN=:RESTRCN_CNSMTNS.RLSD_REQ_ISN
 AND RLSD_HDRS.LOC_EXP_DATE >= V_CHECK_DT
 --AND ( (NVL(RLSD_HDRS.LOC_EFF_EXP_FLAG,0) = 0) OR (RLSD_HDRS.LOC_EFF_EXP_FLAG = 1 AND RLSD_HDRS.LOC_EFF_DATE <= V_CHECK_DT))
 ;
 EXCEPTION
 WHEN OTHERS THEN NULL;
 END;
 ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 IF R_COUNT > 0
 THEN
 STR.DISPALERT('لابد أن يكون تاريخ البيان ضمن الفترة الخاصة بتاريخ فاعلية خطاب الفسح وتاريخ إنتهاء خطاب الفسح','ERROR');
 RAISE FORM_TRIGGER_FAILURE;
 ELSE
 ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 BEGIN
 R_COUNT := 0;
 SELECT COUNT(*)
 INTO R_COUNT
 FROM RLSD_HDRS
 WHERE RLSD_HDRS.LOC_STATUS NOT IN(2,4)
 AND NVL(LOC_STAGE_CODE,0) = V_CHK_DCLN_TYPE
 AND (RLSD_HDRS.BNFCRY_NBR = :GLOBAL.IMPR_NBR OR RLSD_HDRS.IMPR_NBR = :GLOBAL.IMPR_NBR)
 AND RLSD_HDR_ISN=:RESTRCN_CNSMTNS.RLSD_REQ_ISN
 --AND RLSD_HDRS.LOC_EXP_DATE >= V_CHECK_DT
 AND ( (NVL(RLSD_HDRS.LOC_EFF_EXP_FLAG,0) = 0) OR (RLSD_HDRS.LOC_EFF_EXP_FLAG = 1 AND RLSD_HDRS.LOC_EFF_DATE <= V_CHECK_DT))
 ;
 EXCEPTION
 WHEN OTHERS THEN NULL;
 END;
 ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 IF R_COUNT > 0
 THEN
 STR.DISPALERT('لابد أن يكون تاريخ البيان قبل تاريخ إنتهاء خطاب الفسح','ERROR');
 RAISE FORM_TRIGGER_FAILURE;
 ELSE
 STR.DISPALERT('لا يوجد خطاب فسح بهذا الرقم لنفس نوع البيان و لمستورد/لمصدر البيان المعروض','ERROR');
 RAISE FORM_TRIGGER_FAILURE;
 END IF;
 ---------------------------------------------
 END IF;
 ---------------------------------------------
ELSE
 NULL;
END IF;
------------------------------------------------------------------------------
ELSIF :RESTRCN_CNSMTNS.RES_TYPE=2 THEN
 -- Yhelmy CRQ22081 Start
 /*SELECT IM.HQ_IMPR_NBR
 INTO V_HQ_IMPR_NBR
 FROM IMPORTERS IM
 WHERE IM.PORT_CD =:DCLTN_ITEMS.PORT_CD AND
 IM.IMPR_NBR=:GLOBAL.IMPR_NBR;
*/

V_HQ_IMPR_NBR := :DCLTN_HDR.IMPR_NBR ;

-- Yhelmy CRQ22081 END

-- --> 18/07/2009 AHMED A-MONIM Using RLSD_HDRS_CD
/*
SELECT COUNT(*) INTO R_COUNT
FROM EXT_RSTRCT_RLS_REQS WHERE ISSUE_PORT_CD =:DCLTN_HDR.PORT_CD
 AND REQ_ISN =:RESTRCN_CNSMTNS.RLSD_REQ_ISN
 AND DCLTN_ISN =:DCLTN_HDR.DCLTN_ISN
 AND (HQ_BNFCRY_NBR = V_HQ_IMPR_NBR OR HQ_IMPR_NBR = V_HQ_IMPR_NBR)
 AND REQ_STA_CD =2 ;
IF R_COUNT = 0
THEN
 STR.DISPALERT('لا يوجد طلبات خطاب فسح بهذا الرقم لنفس نوع البيان و لمستورد/لمصدر البيان المعروض','ERROR');
 RAISE FORM_TRIGGER_FAILURE;
END IF;
 */
-----------------------------------------
IF :DCLTN_HDR.DCLTN_DT IS NOT NULL THEN
 V_CHECK_DT := :DCLTN_HDR.DCLTN_DT;
ELSE

END IF;
-----------------------------------------
IF :DCLTN_TYPE_CD IN (1,2) THEN

ELSIF :DCLTN_TYPE_CD IN (3,4,5,6) THEN
 V_CHK_DCLN_TYPE := 2 ;

-----------------------------------------
-----------------------------------------

WHERE
--05082009 RLSD_HDR_ISN = :RLSD_REQ_ISN

 OR RLSD_HDRS_HQ.HQ_IMPR_NBR = V_HQ_IMPR_NBR)
AND RLSD_HDRS_HQ.LOC_STATUS <> 2

-- --> 08/08/2012 AHMED A-MONIM To Use LOC_EFF_EXP_FLAG

-- --< 08/08/2012 AHMED A-MONIM To Use LOC_EFF_EXP_FLAG

AND ( (RLSD_HDRS_HQ.ALLOW_TO = 1)

EXCEPTION

------------------------------------------------------------------------------

IF R_COUNT = 0

 AND NVL(RLSD_HDRS_HQ.LOC_STAGE_CODE,0) = V_CHK_DCLN_TYPE

 );

 AND ((NVL(RLSD_HDRS_HQ.LOC_EFF_EXP_FLAG,0) = 0) OR (RLSD_HDRS_HQ.LOC_EFF_EXP_FLAG = 1 AND RLSD_HDRS_HQ.LOC_EFF_DATE <= V_CHECK_DT))

 (SELECT USED_PORT_CD FROM RLSD_HDRS_PORTS_HQ RHP

 )

 END IF;

ELSIF R_COUNT = 1 THEN

PROCEDURE chk_trf_1
IS
 v_loc_eff_date DATE;
BEGIN
 BEGIN
 IF :restrcn_cnsmtns.res_type = 1
 THEN
 BEGIN
 SELECT rlsd_hdrs.loc_eff_date
 INTO v_loc_eff_date
 FROM rlsd_hdrs
 WHERE rlsd_hdrs.port_cd = :restrcn_cnsmtns.port_cd
 AND rlsd_hdrs.rlsd_hdr_isn = :restrcn_cnsmtns.rlsd_req_isn;
 EXCEPTION
 WHEN OTHERS
 THEN
 NULL;
 END;
 ELSIF :restrcn_cnsmtns.res_type = 2
 THEN
 BEGIN
 SELECT rlsd_hdrs_hq.loc_eff_date
 INTO v_loc_eff_date
 FROM rlsd_hdrs_hq
 WHERE rlsd_hdrs_hq.port_cd = :restrcn_cnsmtns.rlsd_port_cd
 AND rlsd_hdrs_hq.rlsd_hdr_isn =
 :restrcn_cnsmtns.ext_req_isn;
 EXCEPTION
 WHEN OTHERS
 THEN
 NULL;
 END;
 END IF;
 EXCEPTION
 WHEN OTHERS
 THEN
 NULL;
 END;

 IF v_loc_eff_date IS NULL
 OR gnrl.get_customs_setting ('RLSD_NEW_TARIFF_DATE', 17) IS NULL
 OR v_loc_eff_date >=
 TO_DATE (
 NVL (gnrl.get_customs_setting ('RLSD_NEW_TARIFF_DATE', 17),
 '1445\01\01'),
 'RRRR\MM\MI')
 THEN
 chk_trf_0;
 ELSE
 DECLARE
 v_count NUMBER (10);
 v_test_qty NUMBER;
 v_rid_hrmnzd_code VARCHAR2 (16);
 v_final_tariff_cd VARCHAR2 (16);
 BEGIN
 v_final_tariff_cd := SUBSTR (:final_tariff_cd, 1, 8);

 IF :restrcn_cnsmtns.res_type = 1
 THEN
 IF :restrcn_cnsmtns.rlsd_req_seq IS NULL
 THEN
 :restrcn_cnsmtns.rlsd_req_seq := NULL;
 :restrcn_cnsmtns.rlsd_itm_seq := NULL;
 :restrcn_cnsmtns.item_qty := NULL;
 :restrcn_cnsmtns.r_qty := NULL;
 :restrcn_cnsmtns.mesured_unit := NULL;
 :restrcn_cnsmtns.item_balnce := NULL;
 RETURN;
 END IF;

 SELECT COUNT (*)
 INTO v_count
 FROM rlsd_items ri
 WHERE ri.port_cd = :dcltn_items.port_cd
 AND ri.rlsd_hdr_isn = :restrcn_cnsmtns.rlsd_req_isn
 AND ri.rlsd_itm_seq = :restrcn_cnsmtns.rlsd_req_seq
 AND NVL (RI.CUSTOMS_APPROVE, 0) <> 2 ---AAA
 AND ( SUBSTR (hrmnzd_code, 1, 8) = v_final_tariff_cd
 OR EXISTS
 (SELECT 1
 FROM rlsd_item_dtls rid
 WHERE rid.port_cd = ri.port_cd
 AND rid.rlsd_hdr_isn = ri.rlsd_hdr_isn
 AND rid.rlsd_itm_seq = ri.rlsd_itm_seq
 AND SUBSTR (rid.hrmnzd_code, 1, 8) =
 v_final_tariff_cd));

 IF v_count > 0
 THEN
 SELECT SUBSTR (ri.hrmnzd_code, 1, 8),
 ri.item_qty,
 ri.msr_unit,
 ri.item_balnce,
 ri.dsc_seq,
 ri.intl_item_qty
 INTO :restrcn_cnsmtns.ri_hrmnzd_code,
 :restrcn_cnsmtns.item_qty,
 :restrcn_cnsmtns.ri_msr_unit,
 :restrcn_cnsmtns.item_balnce,
 :restrcn_cnsmtns.ri_dsc_seq,
 :restrcn_cnsmtns.intl_item_qty
 FROM rlsd_items ri
 WHERE ri.port_cd = :dcltn_items.port_cd
 AND ri.rlsd_hdr_isn = :restrcn_cnsmtns.rlsd_req_isn
 AND ri.rlsd_itm_seq = :restrcn_cnsmtns.rlsd_req_seq
 AND NVL (RI.CUSTOMS_APPROVE, 0) <> 2 ---AAA
 AND ( SUBSTR (hrmnzd_code, 1, 8) = v_final_tariff_cd
 OR EXISTS
 (SELECT 1
 FROM rlsd_item_dtls rid
 WHERE rid.port_cd = ri.port_cd
 AND rid.rlsd_hdr_isn =
 ri.rlsd_hdr_isn
 AND rid.rlsd_itm_seq =
 ri.rlsd_itm_seq
 AND SUBSTR (rid.hrmnzd_code, 1, 8) =
 v_final_tariff_cd));
 END IF;

 IF v_count <= 0
 THEN
 str.dispalert ('مسلسل البند خاطئ', 'ERROR');
 :restrcn_cnsmtns.rlsd_req_seq := NULL;
 :restrcn_cnsmtns.rlsd_itm_seq := NULL;
 :restrcn_cnsmtns.item_qty := NULL;
 :restrcn_cnsmtns.r_qty := NULL;
 :restrcn_cnsmtns.mesured_unit := NULL;
 :restrcn_cnsmtns.item_balnce := NULL;
 RAISE form_trigger_failure;
 END IF;

 IF :item_balnce = 0
 THEN
 str.dispalert ('لا يوجد رصيد للفسح منه',
 'ERROR');
 :restrcn_cnsmtns.rlsd_itm_seq := NULL;
 :restrcn_cnsmtns.rlsd_req_seq := NULL;
 :restrcn_cnsmtns.rlsd_hdr_isn := NULL;
 :restrcn_cnsmtns.rlsd_req_isn := NULL;
 :restrcn_cnsmtns.item_qty := NULL;
 :restrcn_cnsmtns.r_qty := NULL;
 :restrcn_cnsmtns.mesured_unit := NULL;
 :restrcn_cnsmtns.item_balnce := NULL;
 RAISE form_trigger_failure;
 END IF;

 IF :intl_item_qty > 0
 THEN
 -- shehata dm_790 24-12-2020
 /*
 v_test_qty := :intl_qty;
 :mesured_unit := :intl_msr_name;
 */
 v_test_qty := :inv_qty;
 :mesured_unit := :inv_msr_name;
 /* end shehata */
 ELSE
 IF :ri_msr_unit <> :inv_msr_unit
 THEN
 str.dispalert (
 'وحدة قياس البند تختلف عن وحدة قياس الفاتورة',
 'ERROR');
 RAISE form_trigger_failure;
 ELSE
 v_test_qty := :inv_qty;
 :mesured_unit := :inv_msr_name;
 END IF;
 END IF;

 IF :parameter.p_msur_u IS NULL
 THEN
 :parameter.p_msur_u := :mesured_unit;
 ELSE
 IF :parameter.p_msur_u <> :mesured_unit
 THEN
 str.dispalert (
 'وحدة القياس لخطاب فسح السلعة المقيدة مختلفة عن الخطابات السابقة',
 'ERROR');
 RAISE form_trigger_failure;
 END IF;
 END IF;

 :u_qty := v_test_qty;
 :restrcn_cnsmtns.rlsd_hdr_isn := :restrcn_cnsmtns.rlsd_req_isn;
 :restrcn_cnsmtns.rlsd_itm_seq := :restrcn_cnsmtns.rlsd_req_seq;
 ELSIF :restrcn_cnsmtns.res_type = 2
 THEN
 IF :restrcn_cnsmtns.rlsd_req_seq IS NULL
 THEN
 :restrcn_cnsmtns.req_item_seq := NULL;
 :restrcn_cnsmtns.item_qty := NULL;
 :restrcn_cnsmtns.r_qty := NULL;
 :restrcn_cnsmtns.mesured_unit := NULL;
 :restrcn_cnsmtns.item_balnce := NULL;
 RETURN;
 END IF;

 DECLARE
 connection_id exec_sql.conntype;
 cursorid exec_sql.curstype;
 sqlstr VARCHAR2 (2000);
 nign PLS_INTEGER;
 vv_count NUMBER (12);
 BEGIN
 SELECT COUNT (*)
 INTO vv_count
 FROM RLSD_ITEMS_CD RI
 WHERE RI.PORT_CD = :rlsd_port_cd
 AND RI.RLSD_HDR_ISN = :ext_req_isn
 AND RI.RLSD_ITM_SEQ = :rlsd_req_seq
 AND NVL (RI.CUSTOMS_APPROVE, 0) <> 2
 AND ( SUBSTR (hrmnzd_code, 1, 8) = v_final_tariff_cd
 OR EXISTS
 (SELECT 1
 FROM RLSD_ITEM_DTLS_CD RID
 WHERE RID.PORT_CD = RI.PORT_CD
 AND RID.RLSD_HDR_ISN =
 RI.RLSD_HDR_ISN
 AND RID.RLSD_ITM_SEQ =
 RI.RLSD_ITM_SEQ
 AND SUBSTR (RID.HRMNZD_CODE, 1, 8) =
 v_final_tariff_cd));

 v_count := vv_count;
 END;

 IF v_count <= 0
 THEN
 str.dispalert ('مسلسل البند خاطئ', 'ERROR');
 :restrcn_cnsmtns.rlsd_req_seq := NULL;
 :restrcn_cnsmtns.req_item_seq := NULL;
 :restrcn_cnsmtns.item_qty := NULL;
 :restrcn_cnsmtns.r_qty := NULL;
 :restrcn_cnsmtns.mesured_unit := NULL;
 :restrcn_cnsmtns.item_balnce := NULL;
 RAISE form_trigger_failure;
 END IF;

 IF v_count > 0
 THEN
 DECLARE
 connection_id exec_sql.conntype;
 cursorid exec_sql.curstype;
 sqlstr VARCHAR2 (2000);
 nign PLS_INTEGER;
 v_ri_hrmnzd_code VARCHAR2 (16);
 v_item_qty NUMBER (12, 3);
 v_ri_msr_unit NUMBER (10);
 v_item_balnce NUMBER (12, 3);
 v_ri_msr_name VARCHAR2 (30);
 BEGIN
 SELECT SUBSTR (RI.HRMNZD_CODE, 1, 8),
 RI.ITEM_QTY,
 RI.MSR_UNIT,
 RI.ITEM_BALNCE,
 IMU.MSR_ARBC_NAME
 INTO v_rid_hrmnzd_code,
 v_item_qty,
 v_ri_msr_unit,
 v_item_balnce,
 v_ri_msr_name
 FROM MEASURE_UNITS IMU, RLSD_ITEMS_CD RI
 WHERE RI.PORT_CD = :rlsd_port_cd
 AND RI.RLSD_HDR_ISN = :ext_req_isn
 AND RLSD_ITM_SEQ = :rlsd_req_seq
 AND NVL (RI.CUSTOMS_APPROVE, 0) <> 2
 AND RI.MSR_UNIT = IMU.MSR_UNIT(+)
 AND ( SUBSTR (HRMNZD_CODE, 1, 8) =
 v_final_tariff_cd
 OR EXISTS
 (SELECT 1
 FROM RLSD_ITEM_DTLS_CD RID
 WHERE RID.PORT_CD = RI.PORT_CD
 AND RID.RLSD_HDR_ISN =
 RI.RLSD_HDR_ISN
 AND RID.RLSD_ITM_SEQ =
 RI.RLSD_ITM_SEQ
 AND SUBSTR (RID.HRMNZD_CODE,
 1,
 8) =
 v_final_tariff_cd));

 BEGIN
 SELECT SUBSTR (RID.HRMNZD_CODE, 1, 8)
 INTO v_ri_hrmnzd_code
 FROM RLSD_ITEM_DTLS_CD RID
 WHERE RID.PORT_CD = :rlsd_port_cd
 AND RID.RLSD_HDR_ISN = :ext_req_isn
 AND RID.RLSD_ITM_SEQ = :rlsd_req_seq
 AND SUBSTR (RID.HRMNZD_CODE, 1, 8) =
 v_final_tariff_cd;
 EXCEPTION
 WHEN OTHERS
 THEN
 v_ri_hrmnzd_code := v_rid_hrmnzd_code;
 END;

 IF v_item_balnce > v_item_qty
 THEN
 v_item_balnce := v_item_qty;
 END IF;

 :restrcn_cnsmtns.ri_hrmnzd_code :=
 SUBSTR (v_ri_hrmnzd_code, 1, 8);
 :restrcn_cnsmtns.item_qty := v_item_qty;
 :restrcn_cnsmtns.ri_msr_unit := v_ri_msr_unit;
 :restrcn_cnsmtns.item_balnce := v_item_balnce;
 :restrcn_cnsmtns.ri_msr_name := v_ri_msr_name;
 END;

 IF :item_balnce = 0
 THEN
 str.dispalert ('لا يوجد رصيد للفسح منه',
 'ERROR');
 :restrcn_cnsmtns.rlsd_req_seq := NULL;
 :restrcn_cnsmtns.req_item_seq := NULL;
 :restrcn_cnsmtns.item_qty := NULL;
 :restrcn_cnsmtns.r_qty := NULL;
 :restrcn_cnsmtns.mesured_unit := NULL;
 :restrcn_cnsmtns.item_balnce := NULL;
 RAISE form_trigger_failure;
 END IF;
 END IF;

 IF :restrcn_cnsmtns.ri_msr_unit = :inv_msr_unit
 THEN
 :mesured_unit := :inv_msr_name;
 ELSE
 str.dispalert (
 'وحدة قياس البند لطلب خطاب الفسح الخارجى تختلف عن وحدة قياس صنف البيان المراد فسحه',
 'ERROR');
 RAISE form_trigger_failure;
 END IF;

 IF SUBSTR (:restrcn_cnsmtns.ri_hrmnzd_code, 1, 8) <>
 v_final_tariff_cd
 AND SUBSTR (v_rid_hrmnzd_code, 1, 8) <> v_final_tariff_cd
 THEN
 str.dispalert (
 'بند التعرفة لبند طلب خطاب الفسح الخارجى يختلف عن بند التعرفة لصنف البيان المراد فسح',
 'ERROR');
 RAISE form_trigger_failure;
 END IF;

 :u_qty := :inv_qty;
 :restrcn_cnsmtns.req_item_seq := :restrcn_cnsmtns.rlsd_req_seq;
 END IF;
 END;
 END IF;
END;

 AND RID.RLSD_HDR_ISN = :ext_req_isn
 AND RID.RLSD_ITM_SEQ = :rlsd_req_seq
 AND SUBSTR (RID.HRMNZD_CODE, 1, 8) =
 v_final_tariff_cd;
 EXCEPTION
 WHEN OTHERS
 THEN
 v_ri_hrmnzd_code := v_rid_hrmnzd_code;
 END;
 :restrcn_cnsmtns.ri_hrmnzd_code := v_ri_hrmnzd_code;
 :restrcn_cnsmtns.item_qty := v_item_qty;
 :restrcn_cnsmtns.ri_msr_unit := v_ri_msr_unit;
 :restrcn_cnsmtns.item_balnce := v_item_balnce;
 :restrcn_cnsmtns.ri_msr_name := v_ri_msr_name;
 END;

 -------------------------------------------------
 IF :item_balnce = 0
 THEN
 str.dispalert ('لا يوجد رصيد للفسح منه',
 'ERROR');
 :restrcn_cnsmtns.rlsd_req_seq := NULL;
 :restrcn_cnsmtns.req_item_seq := NULL;
 :restrcn_cnsmtns.item_qty := NULL;
 :restrcn_cnsmtns.r_qty := NULL;
 :restrcn_cnsmtns.mesured_unit := NULL;
 :restrcn_cnsmtns.item_balnce := NULL;
 RAISE form_trigger_failure;
 END IF;
 -------------------------------------------------
 END IF;

 IF :restrcn_cnsmtns.ri_msr_unit = :inv_msr_unit
 THEN
 :mesured_unit := :inv_msr_name;
 ELSE
 str.dispalert (
 'وحدة قياس البند لطلب خطاب الفسح الخارجى تختلف عن وحدة قياس صنف البيان المراد فسحه',
 'ERROR');
 RAISE form_trigger_failure;
 END IF;


 IF :restrcn_cnsmtns.ri_hrmnzd_code <> v_final_tariff_cd
 AND v_rid_hrmnzd_code <> v_final_tariff_cd
 THEN
 str.dispalert (
 'بند التعرفة لبند طلب خطاب الفسح الخارجى يختلف عن بند التعرفة لصنف البيان المراد فسح',
 'ERROR');
 RAISE form_trigger_failure;
 END IF;

 :u_qty := :inv_qty;
 :restrcn_cnsmtns.req_item_seq := :restrcn_cnsmtns.rlsd_req_seq;
 END IF;
 END;
END;

ProgramUnit.Name: APPROVE_RELEASE
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE APPROVE_RELEASE IS
BEGIN
 :APRVD := 1;
 IF :INTL_ITEM_QTY = 0 THEN
 IF :RI_MSR_UNIT <> :INV_MSR_UNIT THEN
 MESSAGE('وحدة قياس البند تختلف عن وحدة قياس الفاتورة');
 RAISE FORM_TRIGGER_FAILURE;
 END IF;
 END IF;

 IF :ITEM_BALNCE <= :R_QTY THEN
 :ITEM_BALNCE :=0;
 ELSIF :ITEM_BALNCE > :R_QTY THEN
 :ITEM_BALNCE := :ITEM_BALNCE - :R_QTY;
 END IF;

 IF NVL(:ITEM_BALNCE,0) >= 0 THEN
 UPDATE RLSD_ITEMS
 SET ITEM_BALNCE = :ITEM_BALNCE
 WHERE RLSD_HDR_ISN = :RLSD_HDR_ISN
 AND RLSD_ITM_SEQ = :RLSD_ITM_SEQ
 AND NVL(CUSTOMS_APPROVE,0) <> 2---AAA
 ;

 COMMIT;
 ELSE
 STR.DISPALERT('لم يمكن حسم الكمية والاعتماد', 'ERROR');
 RAISE FORM_TRIGGER_FAILURE;
 END IF;
 END;

ProgramUnit.Name: ADJUST_RLSD_ITEM_BALNC
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
FUNCTION ADJUST_RLSD_ITEM_BALNC (ADJUST_FLAG BOOLEAN)
 RETURN BOOLEAN
IS
 RET BOOLEAN := TRUE;
 V_MAX_QTY NUMBER;
 V_RMN_QTY NUMBER;
 V_TEST_QTY NUMBER;
 V_COUNT NUMBER (10);
 V_ITEM_QTY NUMBER;
 V_INTL_QTY NUMBER;
 V_REQ_ITEM_STA_CD NUMBER;

 V_PORT_CD NUMBER (3);
 V_RLSD_HDR_ISN NUMBER (10);
 V_RLSD_ITM_SEQ NUMBER (5);

 connection_id exec_sql.conntype;
 cursorID exec_sql.curstype;
 sqlstr VARCHAR2 (2000);
 nIgn PLS_INTEGER;
BEGIN
 IF :RESTRCN_CNSMTNS.RES_TYPE = 1
 THEN
 IF :R_QTY IS NOT NULL
 THEN
 SELECT INTL_ITEM_QTY, ITEM_QTY, ITEM_BALNCE
 INTO V_INTL_QTY, V_ITEM_QTY, V_RMN_QTY
 FROM RLSD_ITEMS
 WHERE RLSD_HDR_ISN = :RLSD_HDR_ISN
 AND RLSD_ITM_SEQ = :RLSD_ITM_SEQ
 AND NVL (CUSTOMS_APPROVE, 0) <> 2;

 IF V_INTL_QTY = 0
 THEN
 V_MAX_QTY := V_ITEM_QTY;
 ELSE
 V_MAX_QTY := V_INTL_QTY;
 END IF;

 IF ADJUST_FLAG = TRUE
 THEN
 IF :APRVD = 1
 THEN
 IF V_RMN_QTY + :R_QTY <= V_MAX_QTY
 THEN
 :ITEM_BALNCE := V_RMN_QTY + :R_QTY;

 IF NVL (:SUM_BLANCE, 0) = 0
 THEN
 :PARAMETER.P_MSUR_U := NULL;
 END IF;
 ELSE
 RETURN FALSE;
 END IF;
 END IF;
 ELSE
 IF V_RMN_QTY = 0
 THEN
 STR.DISPALERT ('لا يوجد رصيد للفسح منه',
 'ERROR');
 RAISE Form_Trigger_Failure;
 END IF;
 END IF;

 IF NVL (:ITEM_BALNCE, 0) >= 0
 THEN
 UPDATE RLSD_ITEMS
 SET ITEM_BALNCE = :ITEM_BALNCE
 WHERE RLSD_HDR_ISN = :RLSD_HDR_ISN
 AND RLSD_ITM_SEQ = :RLSD_ITM_SEQ
 AND NVL (CUSTOMS_APPROVE, 0) <> 2;

 FORMS_DDL ('COMMIT');

 IF NOT FORM_SUCCESS
 THEN
 RETURN FALSE;
 END IF;
 ELSE
 RETURN FALSE;
 END IF;

 RETURN TRUE;
 ELSE
 RETURN TRUE;
 END IF;
 ELSIF :RESTRCN_CNSMTNS.RES_TYPE = 2
 THEN
 IF :R_QTY IS NOT NULL
 THEN
 IF ADJUST_FLAG = TRUE
 THEN
 IF :APRVD = 1
 THEN
 SELECT DTL.PORT_CD, DTL.RLSD_HDR_ISN, DTL.RLSD_ITM_SEQ
 INTO V_PORT_CD, V_RLSD_HDR_ISN, V_RLSD_ITM_SEQ
 FROM EXT_RSTRCT_RLS_REQ_DTLS ERRRD,
 RLSD_HDRS_HQ HDR,
 RLSD_ITEMS_HQ DTL
 WHERE ( (ERRRD.ISSUE_PORT_CD = :RESTRCN_CNSMTNS.PORT_CD)
 AND (ERRRD.REQ_ISN = :RESTRCN_CNSMTNS.REQ_ISN)
 AND (ERRRD.REQ_ITEM_SEQ =
 :RESTRCN_CNSMTNS.REQ_ITEM_SEQ)
 AND (ERRRD.RLS_LTR_PORT_CD = HDR.PORT_CD)
 AND (ERRRD.RLSD_LOC_NBR = HDR.LOC_NBR)
 AND (ERRRD.RLSD_LOC_DATE = HDR.LOC_DATE)
 AND (ERRRD.RAC_ATHRTY_CD = HDR.RAC_ATHRTY_CD)
 AND (ERRRD.RAC_ATHRTY_SUB_CD = HDR.RAC_ATHRTY_SUB_CD)
 AND (HDR.RLSD_HDR_ISN = DTL.RLSD_HDR_ISN)
 AND (HDR.PORT_CD = DTL.PORT_CD)
 AND (ERRRD.RLSD_ITEM_SEQ = DTL.RLSD_ITM_SEQ)
 AND NVL (DTL.CUSTOMS_APPROVE, 0) <> 2);

 IF :RLSD_PORT_CD = 10 AND :PARAMETER.P_CURR_PORT_CD = 17
 THEN
 BEGIN
 UPDATE RLSD_ITEMS_10
 SET ITEM_BALNCE = ITEM_BALNCE + :R_QTY
 WHERE PORT_CD = V_PORT_CD
 AND RLSD_HDR_ISN = V_RLSD_HDR_ISN
 AND RLSD_ITM_SEQ = V_RLSD_ITM_SEQ
 AND NVL (CUSTOMS_APPROVE, 0) <> 2;
 EXCEPTION
 WHEN OTHERS
 THEN
 --str.dispalert (ERROR_CODE||' '||ERROR_TYPE||' '||ERROR_TEXT||' '||SQLCODE||' '||SQLERRM, 'ERROR');
 NULL;
 END;

 RETURN TRUE;
 ELSE
 connection_id := EXEC_SQL.CURR_CONNECTION;
 cursorID := exec_sql.open_cursor (connection_id);
 sqlstr :=
 'UPDATE RLSD_ITEMS_'
 || :RLSD_PORT_CD
 || ' SET ITEM_BALNCE = ITEM_BALNCE + '
 || ''''
 || :R_QTY
 || ''''
 || ' '
 || ' WHERE PORT_CD = '
 || ''''
 || V_PORT_CD
 || ''''
 || ' AND RLSD_HDR_ISN = '
 || ''''
 || V_RLSD_HDR_ISN
 || ''''
 || ' AND RLSD_ITM_SEQ = '
 || ''''
 || V_RLSD_ITM_SEQ
 || ''''
 || ' '
 || ' AND NVL(CUSTOMS_APPROVE,0) <> 2 ';
 exec_sql.parse (connection_id, cursorID, sqlstr);
 nIgn := exec_sql.execute (connection_id, cursorID);

 IF NOT FORM_SUCCESS
 THEN
 RETURN FALSE;
 END IF;
 END IF;

 :GLOBAL.DEL_EXT := 1;
 RETURN TRUE;
 ELSE
 RETURN FALSE;
 END IF;
 ELSE
 IF :APRVD = 0
 THEN
 IF :RLSD_PORT_CD = 10 AND :PARAMETER.P_CURR_PORT_CD = 17
 THEN
 BEGIN
 UPDATE RLSD_ITEMS_10
 SET ITEM_BALNCE = :ITEM_BALNCE
 WHERE PORT_CD = :RLSD_PORT_CD
 AND RLSD_HDR_ISN = :EXT_REQ_ISN
 AND RLSD_ITM_SEQ = :RLSD_REQ_SEQ
 AND NVL (CUSTOMS_APPROVE, 0) <> 2;
 EXCEPTION
 WHEN OTHERS
 THEN
 --str.dispalert (ERROR_CODE||' '||ERROR_TYPE||' '||ERROR_TEXT||' '||SQLCODE||' '||SQLERRM, 'ERROR');
 NULL;
 END;

 CR_EXT_RLS_REQ;
 RETURN TRUE;
 ELSE
 connection_id := EXEC_SQL.CURR_CONNECTION;
 cursorID := exec_sql.open_cursor (connection_id);
 sqlstr :=
 'UPDATE RLSD_ITEMS_'
 || :RLSD_PORT_CD
 || ' SET ITEM_BALNCE = '
 || ''''
 || :ITEM_BALNCE
 || ''''
 || ' '

ProgramUnit.Name: ADJ_FUNS
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE ADJ_FUNS IS
BEGIN

--&&& BY MOHAMED ABD EL_MONEM (EXT. : 4853) @ 23/03/2005 IN ORDER TO CORRECT ERRORS WHICH APPEAR AFTER NEW LIB.
/*DCLTN.ADJ_DCLTN_FUNS(:PARAMETER.P_DCLTN_TYPE,:DCLTN_STA_CD,:PARAMETER.P_TASK_ID,
 :PARAMETER.P_LEVEL, :PARAMETER.P_PORT_TYPE);*/
 DCLTN_FN.ADJ_DCLTN_FUNS(:PARAMETER.P_DCLTN_TYPE,:DCLTN_STA_CD,:PARAMETER.P_TASK_ID,
 :PARAMETER.P_LEVEL, :PARAMETER.P_PORT_TYPE);
--&&& END
 DECLARE

 found NUMBER;


 BEGIN

 SELECT 1
 INTO found
 FROM rlsd_hdrs, sign_pics
 WHERE
 rlsd_hdrs.rlsd_hdr_isn = :RESTRCN_CNSMTNS.rlsd_hdr_isn
 AND rlsd_hdrs.port_cd = :RESTRCN_CNSMTNS.port_cd
 AND sign_pics.athrty_CD = rlsd_hdrs.rac_athrty_cd
 AND sign_pics.athrty_sub_cd = rlsd_hdrs.rac_athrty_sub_cd
 AND sign_pics.athrty_seq = rlsd_hdrs.athrty_seq
 AND ROWNUM<=1
 ;
 TMPLT.ENABLE_FUN('CD_02180');
 EXCEPTION WHEN NO_DATA_FOUND THEN
 TMPLT.DISABLE_FUN('CD_02180');
 END;

END;

ProgramUnit.Name: DECLTN_LOV
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE DECLTN_LOV IS
 pl_id ParamList;
 pl_name VARCHAR2(100) := 'DCLTN_PARAM';

 RET NUMBER;

 BEGIN
 pl_id := Get_Parameter_List(pl_name);
 IF Id_Null(pl_id) THEN
 pl_id := Create_Parameter_List(pl_name);
 IF Id_Null(pl_id) THEN
 ret := Str.Dispalert('Error creating parameter list '||pl_name, 'SYSTEM_ERROR');
 RAISE Form_Trigger_Failure;
 END IF;

 Add_Parameter(pl_id, 'WINDOW_TITLE', TEXT_PARAMETER, 'قائمة إختيار البيان');
 Add_Parameter(pl_id, 'DCLTN_NBR', TEXT_PARAMETER, :DCLTN_HDR.DCLTN_NBR);
 Add_Parameter(pl_id, 'PORT_CD', TEXT_PARAMETER, :DCLTN_HDR.PORT_CD);
 Add_Parameter(pl_id, 'DCLTN_TYPE_CD', TEXT_PARAMETER, :DCLTN_HDR.DCLTN_TYPE_CD);

 CALL_FORM('LOV_DCLTN.fmx',
 no_hide,
 no_replace,
 no_query_only,
 pl_id);

 IF :GLOBAL.DCLTN_NBR IS NOT NULL THEN
 :DCLTN_HDR.DCLTN_ISN := :GLOBAL.DCLTN_ISN;
 :DCLTN_HDR.DCLTN_NBR := :GLOBAL.DCLTN_NBR;
 :DCLTN_HDR.DCLTN_DT := :GLOBAL.DCLTN_DT;

 END IF;


 Destroy_Parameter_List(pl_id);
 ELSE
 ret := Str.DispAlert('Parameter list '||pl_name||' already exists!','INFORMATION');
 RAISE Form_Trigger_Failure;
 END IF;
 END;

ProgramUnit.Name: CALL_SD_PORTS_LOV
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE CALL_SD_PORTS_LOV(V_PORT_CD VARCHAR2, V_PORT_NAME VARCHAR2, V_PORT_TYPE VARCHAR2) IS
 pl_id ParamList;
 pl_name VARCHAR2(100) := 'SD_PORT_LOV';
 RET NUMBER;
BEGIN
 :GLOBAL.PORT_CD := NULL;
 :GLOBAL.PORT_TYPE := NULL;
 :GLOBAL.PORT_NAME := NULL;

 pl_id := Get_Parameter_List(pl_name);
 IF Id_Null(pl_id) THEN
 pl_id := Create_Parameter_List(pl_name);
 IF Id_Null(pl_id) THEN
 ret := Str.Dispalert('Error creating parameter list '||pl_name, 'SYSTEM_ERROR');
 RAISE Form_Trigger_Failure;
 END IF;
 Add_Parameter(pl_id, 'WINDOW_TITLE', TEXT_PARAMETER, 'الجمارك السعوديه');
 Add_Parameter(pl_id, 'WINDOW_WIDTH', TEXT_PARAMETER, 7.1);
 CALL_FORM('LOV_SD_PORTS.fmx',
 no_hide,
 no_replace,
 no_query_only,
 pl_id);
 Destroy_Parameter_List(pl_id);
 ELSE
 ret := Str.DispAlert('Parameter list '||pl_name||' already exists!','INFORMATION');
 RAISE Form_Trigger_Failure;
 END IF;

 IF :GLOBAL.PORT_CD IS NOT NULL THEN
 IF V_PORT_CD IS NOT NULL THEN
 COPY(:GLOBAL.PORT_CD, V_PORT_CD);
 END IF;

 IF V_PORT_NAME IS NOT NULL THEN
 COPY(:GLOBAL.PORT_NAME, V_PORT_NAME);
 END IF;

 IF V_PORT_TYPE IS NOT NULL THEN
 COPY(:GLOBAL.PORT_TYPE, V_PORT_TYPE);
 END IF;
 END IF;

END CALL_SD_PORTS_LOV;

 set_alert_property(alert_is, ALERT_MESSAGE_TEXT, MsgTxt );
 alert_button := show_alert(alert_is);
 else
 Message(MsgTxt);
 end if;
 TIMER_ID := FIND_TIMER('ON_MESSAGE_TIMER');
 IF NOT ID_NULL(TIMER_ID) THEN
 DELETE_TIMER(TIMER_ID);
 END IF;

 TIMER_ID := CREATE_TIMER('ON_MESSAGE_TIMER', 1, REPEAT);
 END;
*/
NIB.ON_MESSAGE;

/* CGBS$KEY_CLRBLK_FRM */

 END IF;
 clear_block( NO_VALIDATE );
END;

Trigger.Name: KEY-F9
Trigger.TriggerText:
/* CGAP$TES_SEQUENCE_BEFORE */
DECLARE
 PROP VARCHAR2(10);
 VIS VARCHAR2(200);
 V_FUN VARCHAR2(200);
BEGIN
 VIS := GET_VIEW_PROPERTY('LSIDE', VISIBLE);
 V_FUN := GET_ITEM_PROPERTY('FUN_BUT',VISIBLE);

 IF VIS = 'TRUE' THEN
 SET_VIEW_PROPERTY('LSIDE', VISIBLE, PROPERTY_FALSE);
 GO_ITEM(NAME_IN('PARAMETER.P_CURRENT_ITEM'));
 COPY('', 'PARAMETER.P_CURRENT_ITEM');
 ELSE
 IF V_FUN = 'TRUE' THEN
 COPY(NAME_IN('SYSTEM.CURSOR_ITEM'), 'PARAMETER.P_CURRENT_ITEM');
 ADJ_FUNS;
 GO_ITEM('DUMMY');

 TMPLT.Populate_Functions;
 TMPLT.USING_KEYB := TRUE;
 TMPLT.CURSOR_AT := 1;
 TMPLT.KEYB_UP_DOWN(0);
 END IF;
 END IF;
END;

Trigger.Name: KEY-HELP
Trigger.TriggerText:
/* CGHP$CALL_HELP_FORM */
/* Call the help system after setting globals with current block and item */
BEGIN
 :GLOBAL.CG$HP_HFILE := '';
 IF (:GLOBAL.CG$HP_HFILE IS NULL) THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH(Des$Form_errors.MSGGETTEXT(23, 'Help file is missing or incorrect'), 'W', 'OFG', 23);
 ELSE
 :GLOBAL.CG$HP_HFILE := :GLOBAL.CG$HP_HPATH || '';
 BEGIN
 CGHP$CALL_MS_HELP(
 0 /* IN : Help Context Id */
 ,:GLOBAL.CG$HP_HFILE); /* IN : Help Resource File */
 EXCEPTION
 WHEN OTHERS THEN
 CGTE$OTHER_EXCEPTIONS;
 END;
 END IF;
END;

Trigger.Name: ON-CLEAR-DETAILS
Trigger.TriggerText:
/* CGBS$ON_CLEAR_DETAILS */
/* clear all detail blocks for the given master block */
BEGIN
 IF (FORM_FAILURE AND :SYSTEM.COORDINATION_OPERATION IN ('MOUSE', 'DUPLICATE_RECORD')) THEN
 RAISE FORM_TRIGGER_FAILURE;
 END IF;
 IF (:SYSTEM.MASTER_BLOCK = :SYSTEM.TRIGGER_BLOCK) THEN
 CGBS$.CLEAR_MASTER_DETAIL( :SYSTEM.MASTER_BLOCK, :SYSTEM.COORDINATION_OPERATION );
 END IF;
END;

Trigger.Name: ON-POPULATE-DETAILS
Trigger.TriggerText:
/* CGBS$ON_POPULATE_DETAILS */
/* query all detail blocks for the given master block */
BEGIN
 CGBS$.QUERY_DETAILS( :SYSTEM.CURSOR_BLOCK, :GLOBAL.CG$QUERY_MODE );
END;

Trigger.Name: KEY-CLRREC
Trigger.TriggerText:
/* CGBS$KEY_CLRREC */
/* Avoid clearing details if current row is new and invalid */
BEGIN

 IF (:SYSTEM.BLOCK_STATUS = 'CHANGED' OR CGBS2$.IS_COMMIT_NEEDED( :SYSTEM.TRIGGER_BLOCK ) ) THEN

 END IF;
 clear_record;
END;

Trigger.Name: KEY-MENU
Trigger.TriggerText:
/* CGBS$TOGGLE_QUERY_MODE */
/* This changes the mode of block synchronization so that if it is */

/* new mode. */
BEGIN

END;
